Questions 11–12 form a group.

In 2015 the U.S. Food and Drug Administration approved the marketing of a salmon produced by biotechnology. The process by which this salmon was produced is briefly as follows: scientists introduced into Atlantic salmon the promoter of the antifreeze protein gene of ocean pout and the growth hormone gene of Chinook salmon, using the promoter of the ocean pout antifreeze protein gene to drive the Chinook salmon growth hormone gene. After this improvement, the Atlantic salmon grows faster.

(A) The antifreeze protein from ocean pout in its body increases

Reading 1: Questions 36–38 form a group.

Most voles, such as the meadow vole, have a polygynandrous mating system (multiple mates for both sexes); the prairie vole, however, is monogamous, and a female mates with only one male. Scientists found that oxytocin receptors in the brain of the prairie vole are clearly more abundant than in other vole species. If the interaction between oxytocin and its receptor in a female prairie vole is weakened with a drug, the female loses her monogamous (one-male) behavior. On the other hand, the brain of the male prairie vole also has clearly more receptors for arginine vasopressin (AVP) than polygynous male voles. If the interaction between AVP and its receptor is blocked, the male also becomes "unfaithful". Scientists cloned the AVP receptor gene of the prairie vole and transferred it into the brain of experimental mice, which are polygynous, and found that these mice gave up their polygynous behavior. Answer Questions 36–38 based on this passage and related knowledge.

大多數的田鼠（vole），如草甸田鼠（meadow vole）等其生殖行為是多夫多妻制；然而草原田鼠（prairie vole）卻是行一夫一妻的生殖行為，其雌鼠只會與一隻雄鼠交配。科學家分析發現在草原田鼠的大腦內，催產素受體明顯比其他種類田鼠多。如果以藥劑減弱雌性草原田鼠的催產素與其受體作用，則此雌性田鼠的一夫行為會消失。另一方面，雄性草原田鼠大腦內的血管加壓素（arginine vasopressin, AVP）的受體也明顯比多妻雄田鼠多。若阻斷AVP與其受體作用，則此雄鼠也會變得「不專情」。科學家選殖出草原田鼠的AVP受體基因，並將其轉殖到具多妻行為的實驗小鼠（mice）大腦中，結果發現此實驗小鼠會放棄其多妻的行為。依據本文及相關知識回答第36~38題。

The lung has long been regarded as an important respiratory organ, but in fact the complexity of lung function far exceeds our present understanding. Recent studies indicate that the lung also plays an important role in platelet production. Megakaryocytes are the precursor cells of platelets; when parts of the edge of the plasma membrane of a mature megakaryocyte rupture and shed, the shed portions containing plasma membrane form platelets. Using biotechnology, researchers produced PF4-mTmG mice from mTmG mice. Unlike mTmG mice, PF4-mTmG mice produce megakaryocytes carrying green fluorescent protein (GFP) (GFP-megakaryocytes), and 2-photon intravital microscopy (2PIVM) was then used to observe GFP-megakaryocytes in tissues and the GFP-platelets produced when they rupture. The results showed that, besides large numbers of megakaryocytes in the lung, large numbers of platelets are produced and released there, with an estimated output of about 50% of all platelets of the mouse. In organ transplantation experiments the researchers then found that if the lung of a PF4-mTmG mouse is transplanted into an mTmG mouse, the transplanted PF4-mTmG lung loses the ability to produce GFP-platelets; however, if the lung of an mTmG mouse is transplanted into a PF4-mTmG mouse, large numbers of GFP-megakaryocytes and GFP-platelets are found in the transplanted mTmG lung. In addition, later studies further showed that the megakaryocytes appearing in the lung actually originate from the bone marrow, and then gather in the lung through blood circulation and produce platelets there. Answer Questions 39–41 based on this passage and related knowledge.

肺臟一向被視為是重要的呼吸器官，但事實上肺臟功能的複雜度遠超過我們目前的認知。近期研究指出，肺臟也在血小板生成中扮演重要角色。巨核細胞（megakaryocyte）是血小板的前驅細胞，當成熟巨核細胞的細胞膜邊緣部份破裂剝落後，含有細胞膜的剝落部分就會形成血小板。研究者運用生物技術，由mTmG小鼠產生了PF4-mTmG小鼠。有別於mTmG小鼠，PF4-mTmG小鼠可產生帶有綠螢光蛋白（GFP）的巨核細胞（GFP-巨核細胞），其後利用2PIV顯微鏡術（2-photo intravital microscopy; 2PIVM）觀測在組織中的GFP-巨核細胞及其破裂產生之GFP-血小板。研究結果顯示，肺部發現有大量巨核細胞外，且有大量的血小板產生與釋放，估計產生量約占小鼠全部血小板的50%。研究者接著在器官移植的實驗發現，若將PF4-mTmG小鼠的肺臟植入mTmG小鼠中，植入後的PF4-mTmG小鼠肺臟會失去產生GFP-血小板的能力；然而若將mTmG小鼠肺臟植入PF4-mTmG小鼠中，則會發現在植入的mTmG小鼠肺臟中有GFP-巨核細胞與GFP-血小板的大量出現。此外，後續的研究則進一步證明，在肺臟出現的巨核細胞其實應源自於骨髓，之後經血液循環聚集於肺臟並產生血小板。依本文所述及相關知識，回答第39~41題。

(C) 是一種產生GFP-巨核細胞的技術

(D) 是一種可促進巨核細胞產生血小板的技術

Reading 3: Questions 42–43 form a group.

Viola hondoensis is a perennial herb that grows under temperate deciduous forest. The plant produces new leaves mainly in two seasons: leaves that sprout in April (called summer leaves) drop in September; leaves that sprout in September (called winter leaves) drop in May of the following year. Researchers wanted to understand why the winter leaves of Viola hondoensis still drop in the following spring, when the climate has become suitable for growth. They proposed four hypotheses: Hypothesis (1): it is affected by environmental factors that differ between seasons (such as temperature and changes in day length); Hypothesis (2): the leaves of the forest canopy grow out and cause a shading effect; Hypothesis (3): the newly grown summer leaves shade the winter leaves; Hypothesis (4): the newly grown summer leaves compete with the winter leaves for nutrients.

To test these hypotheses, the researchers carried out three manipulation experiments that changed the environment of the winter leaves of Viola hondoensis. The experimental procedures (left column of the table below) and results (right column) are as follows:

$$\begin{array}{|l|l|}\hline \text{Experiment 1: In April, 10 artificially raised Viola hondoensis plants were transplanted and grown in an open field.} & \begin{array}{l}\text{1. The winter leaves of the control plants dropped in May.}\\ \text{2. The winter leaves of the experimental plants dropped in April.}\end{array} \\ \hline \text{Experiment 2: Under the deciduous forest, 10 Viola hondoensis plants were selected and their summer leaves and winter leaves were arranged so as not to overlap.} & \begin{array}{l}\text{1. The winter leaves of the control plants dropped in May.}\\ \text{2. The winter leaves of the experimental plants dropped in August.}\end{array} \\ \hline \text{Experiment 3: Under the deciduous forest, 10 Viola hondoensis plants were selected and their nutrient-consuming organs were removed.} & \begin{array}{l}\text{1. The winter leaves of the control plants dropped in May.}\\ \text{2. The winter leaves of the experimental plants dropped in July.}\end{array} \\ \hline \end{array}$$

Answer Questions 42–43 based on this passage.

42. Which of the following statements about the experimental design is correct?

(A) The experimental group of Experiment 1 makes the summer leaves not shaded by the winter leaves

(B) The experimental group of Experiment 2 makes the winter leaves not shaded by the summer leaves

(C) The control group of Experiment 2 consists of 10 plants selected under the deciduous forest whose summer leaves are removed

(D) The control group of Experiment 3 consists of 10 plants selected under the deciduous forest that are given fertilizer

日本菫菜（Viola hondoensis）是一種多年生的草本植物，生長在溫帶落葉林下，此植株主要在兩個季節萌發新葉︰四月萌發的葉子（稱為夏葉）到九月會掉落；九月萌發的葉子（稱為冬葉）則到隔年五月時會掉落。學者想要瞭解為什麼在氣候變得適合生長時，日本菫菜冬葉仍會在隔年春天時掉落？他們提出四個假設：假設(1)受到不同季節的環境因子（如氣溫、日照長短變化）之影響；假設(2)樹林冠層的葉子長出，造成遮光效應；假設(3)新長出的夏葉遮蔽了冬葉；假設(4)新長出的夏葉和冬葉競爭養分。

為了檢驗這些假設，學者進行三項改變日本菫菜冬葉環境的操縱實驗，實驗內容（下表左列）和結果（下表右列）如下：

$$\begin{array}{|l|l|}\hline \text{實驗一、在四月時，將10株人工培育的日本菫菜，移植到空曠地栽種。} & \begin{array}{l}\text{1.對照組植株的冬葉在五月時掉落。}\\ \text{2.實驗組植株的冬葉在四月掉落。}\end{array} \\ \hline \text{實驗二、在落葉林下選擇10株日本菫菜，將其夏葉與冬葉的葉片錯開。} & \begin{array}{l}\text{1.對照組植株的冬葉在五月時掉落。}\\ \text{2.實驗組植株的冬葉在八月掉落。}\end{array} \\ \hline \text{實驗三、在落葉林下選擇10株日本菫菜，移除其消耗養分的器官。} & \begin{array}{l}\text{1.對照組植株的冬葉在五月時掉落。}\\ \text{2.實驗組植株的冬葉在七月掉落。}\end{array} \\ \hline \end{array}$$

Reading 3: Questions 42–43 form a group.

Viola hondoensis is a perennial herb that grows under temperate deciduous forest. The plant produces new leaves mainly in two seasons: leaves that sprout in April (called summer leaves) drop in September; leaves that sprout in September (called winter leaves) drop in May of the following year. Researchers wanted to understand why the winter leaves of Viola hondoensis still drop in the following spring, when the climate has become suitable for growth. They proposed four hypotheses: Hypothesis (1): it is affected by environmental factors that differ between seasons (such as temperature and changes in day length); Hypothesis (2): the leaves of the forest canopy grow out and cause a shading effect; Hypothesis (3): the newly grown summer leaves shade the winter leaves; Hypothesis (4): the newly grown summer leaves compete with the winter leaves for nutrients.

To test these hypotheses, the researchers carried out three manipulation experiments that changed the environment of the winter leaves of Viola hondoensis. The experimental procedures (left column of the table below) and results (right column) are as follows:

$$\begin{array}{|l|l|}\hline \text{Experiment 1: In April, 10 artificially raised Viola hondoensis plants were transplanted and grown in an open field.} & \begin{array}{l}\text{1. The winter leaves of the control plants dropped in May.}\\ \text{2. The winter leaves of the experimental plants dropped in April.}\end{array} \\ \hline \text{Experiment 2: Under the deciduous forest, 10 Viola hondoensis plants were selected and their summer leaves and winter leaves were arranged so as not to overlap.} & \begin{array}{l}\text{1. The winter leaves of the control plants dropped in May.}\\ \text{2. The winter leaves of the experimental plants dropped in August.}\end{array} \\ \hline \text{Experiment 3: Under the deciduous forest, 10 Viola hondoensis plants were selected and their nutrient-consuming organs were removed.} & \begin{array}{l}\text{1. The winter leaves of the control plants dropped in May.}\\ \text{2. The winter leaves of the experimental plants dropped in July.}\end{array} \\ \hline \end{array}$$

Answer Questions 42–43 based on this passage.

43. Which of the following statements about the experimental results is correct?

(A) The result of Experiment 1 supports Hypothesis (1)

(B) The result of Experiment 2 supports Hypothesis (3)

(C) The result of Experiment 3 supports Hypothesis (2)

(D) The results of Experiments 2 and 3 support Hypothesis (4)

Scientists have observed, in fossils of organisms from the end of the Jurassic, the phenomenon of leaves specializing into pistils, and phylogenetic tree analysis has confirmed that an evergreen shrub, Amborella, should be a descendant of the oldest flowering plants. It may have arisen when a gymnosperm underwent an occasional chromosome doubling, producing new gene expression that promoted the formation of flowers. Through studies of mutant plants, scientists have unraveled the molecular regulatory mechanism of flower development. The structure of the flower is determined mainly by the mutual regulation of three groups of organ identity genes, XYZ. As shown in Figure 10, genes X and Z inhibit each other. When gene Z is inhibited, gene X is expressed in large amounts, which causes the pistil to become a sepal; conversely, when only gene Z is expressed, a pistil develops, and when gene Z is expressed in large amounts, the number of stamens, pistils and so on increases.

Further research found that different plant species all have similar gene families, and mainly through the evolution of MADS regulatory genes, the activity of the promoters of the XYZ genes in specific cells is initiated, which promotes the differentiation and transformation of floral structures. These research results have already been applied to develop new varieties of ornamental flowers. Based on the text above and related knowledge, answer the following questions:

科學家由侏羅紀末期的生物化石觀察到葉特化成雌蕊的現象，利用演化樹分析證實一種常綠灌木－無油樟（Amborella）應為最古老開花植物的後代。它可能是某裸子植物因偶發染色體倍增，產生新的基因表現，促成花的形成。科學家經由突變植物的研究，解開花發育的分子調控機制。花的結構主要由XYZ三組器官定位基因（organ identity genes）相互調控所決定。如圖10所示，其中X和Z基因互相抑制，當Z基因受到抑制時，X基因會大量表現，會導致雌蕊變成花萼，反之當只有Z基因表現時，會發育成雌蕊，而當Z基因大量表現時，會增加雄蕊與雌蕊等的數目。

進一步研究發現，不同植物物種皆具有相似的基因家族，且主要藉由MADS調節基因的演化，來啟動特定細胞中XYZ基因啟動子的活性，以促進花構造的分化及變形。這些研究成果已應用於開發觀賞花卉的新品種。根據上文所述及相關知識，回答下列問題：

Reading 2: Questions 39–41 form a group.

For a long time, the scientific community generally believed that neutrophils clear invading microorganisms by endocytosis (phagocytosis) and by releasing peptides (antimicrobial peptides) that can kill bacteria and are contained in their granules. In recent years, however, scientists have discovered a new immune mechanism, called neutrophil extracellular traps (NETs). The formation and mode of action of NETs are briefly described as follows: when receptors on a neutrophil receive a foreign stimulus, large amounts of reactive oxygen free radicals are produced inside the cell. When these reactive oxygen free radicals accumulate in the cell, the structure of the nuclear envelope and the granules in the cytoplasm become unstable. Then the membrane integrity of the nucleus and of the granules begins to be lost, and nuclear material and loose genomic DNA gradually fill the whole cell and fuse with the antimicrobial peptides in the granules. Finally, the cell rounds up and contracts to expel the NETs. NETs contain unfixed, loose nuclear chromatin DNA that catches microorganisms around the cell like a fishing net, while other substances on the NETs can kill the microorganisms. In certain specific situations, NETs clear foreign microorganisms more efficiently than the phagocytosis we knew about before. Based on the text above and related knowledge, answer the following questions:

When heat-sensitive neurons of the somatosensory system detect noxious heat stimuli, these neurons produce a heat-avoidance response to avoid injury, but how heat-sensitive neurons receive heat stimuli to trigger nerve impulses has not yet been clarified. Scientists believe that certain heat-sensitive channel proteins play an important role in this mechanism, including the heat-sensitive channel proteins TRPV1 and TRPM3 of the transient receptor potential ion channel family (TRP ion channel family). Scientists used gene knockout technology to eliminate the function of specific proteins, producing single-gene knockout mice or double-gene knockout mice; the labels of the mice produced after gene knockout are shown in the table. The comparison results show that the three kinds of mice, $\mathrm{TRPV1^{-/-}}$, $\mathrm{TRPM3^{-/-}}$ and $\mathrm{DKO^{V1/M3}}$, all show only mild deficits in the heat-avoidance response.

Recent studies found another heat-sensitive channel protein, TRPA1, on heat-sensitive neurons that have the two channel proteins mentioned above. Similarly to before, $\mathrm{TRPA1^{-/-}}$ mice can still have a normal heat-avoidance response, and $\mathrm{DKO^{A1/V1}}$ and $\mathrm{DKO^{A1/M3}}$ mice also show only mild deficits in the heat-avoidance response. It was not until scientists produced triple-gene knockout mice (TKO) that these mice lost the great majority of the heat-avoidance response. Scientists also found that although the gene-knockout mice and normal mice (WT) have similar temperature preferences, TKO mice have greater temperature endurance than the other mice.

Questions 12–13 form a group.

Austronesian peoples are widely distributed across the islands of the Pacific. When Austronesian peoples migrated, they carried female trees of the “paper mulberry”, which can serve as a material for weaving cloth, to new islands and planted them by cuttings. Maternal inheritance means that hereditary traits are determined by the egg cell, because its cytoplasm contains a large amount of mRNA and organelles carrying genetic material, which can determine the characteristics of the offspring. Scientists found that the chloroplast DNA of Taiwanese paper mulberry contains a special CP-17 genotype, and that the chloroplasts of paper mulberry on the Pacific islands also all carry the same genotype, showing that the paper mulberry of the Pacific islands is very closely related to that of Taiwan. This study provides a supporting argument for the “Out of Taiwan” hypothesis established by linguistics.

12. Why did the scientists use the CP-17 genotype of paper mulberry chloroplasts to investigate the relationship between the peoples of Taiwan and the Austronesian-speaking regions?

(A) Chloroplast genes are simpler than the chromosomes of paper mulberry cells

(B) Chloroplasts contain a large amount of mRNA, making it easy to study the CP-17 genotype

(C) Chloroplasts are a factor of maternal inheritance

(D) Chloroplasts exist in paper mulberry cells and themselves carry no chromosomes
problems.problem_orig:
[單選題]

12-13題為題組

南島語系族群廣泛分布於太平洋島嶼，當南島民族遷徙時，將可當織布材料的「構樹」雌株樹種攜帶到新的島嶼，以扦插方式種植。母體遺傳是指遺傳特性由卵細胞決定，因為其細胞質內含有大量mRNA及帶有遺傳物質的胞器，可決定子代的特徵。科學家發現臺灣構樹葉綠體DNA中含有特殊的CP-17基因型，而太平洋島嶼的構樹葉綠體也都帶有同樣的基因型，顯示太平洋島嶼構樹與臺灣構樹親緣關係十分接近，此研究提供了語言學所建立的「出臺灣說」一個論證的依據。

12. 科學家為什麼以構樹葉綠體的CP-17基因型，探究臺灣與南島語系地區之族群關聯性？

Reading 1: Questions 36–38 form a group.

How does sleep fragmentation promote the development of cardiovascular disease? To answer this question, scientists used Apoe gene knockout mice (Apoe$^{-/-}$ mice), which are prone to atherosclerosis, and divided them into two groups for experiments: a sleep-continuity group (SC) and a sleep-fragmentation group (SF). The results showed that, compared with SC, SF developed signs of atherosclerosis, and large numbers of Ly-6C$^{\mathrm{high}}$ monocytes and neutrophils were found in the arteries; however, the numbers of B cells and other lymphocytes did not change significantly, and there was no weight gain. In addition, hypocretin (abbreviated Hcrt), which is produced by the hypothalamus, was also found to be decreased in SF, but dynorphin, a transmitter that assists Hcrt, showed no difference in expression in SF. If SF mice were then given uninterrupted sleep, these mice could again produce Hcrt and had normal numbers of Ly-6C$^{\mathrm{high}}$ monocytes and neutrophils. In another experiment, under a high-fat diet, the signs of atherosclerosis and the numbers of Ly-6C$^{\mathrm{high}}$ monocytes and neutrophils in Apoe$^{-/-}$Hcrt$^{-/-}$ mice, in which two genes were knocked out at the same time, increased and were more severe than in Apoe$^{-/-}$ mice with a single gene knocked out. Research shows that adequate sleep is a mechanism that helps maintain cardiovascular health. Based on the text above and the knowledge you have acquired, answer the following questions.

36. According to the effects of sleep fragmentation described in the text above, which of the following statements are correct?

(A) It increases the number of specific cells in the blood

(B) The expression of the assisting transmitter dynorphin shows no difference, causing Hcrt to lose its function

(C) The absence of weight gain is the main cause of atherosclerosis

(D) The expression level of Hcrt shows a negative correlation with the change in the number of Ly-6C$^{\mathrm{high}}$ monocytes in the arteries

(E) The decrease in Hcrt expression caused by sleep fragmentation is an irreversible reaction

閱讀一

睡眠片段化如何促使心血管疾病的發生？為解答此問題，科學家使用易罹患動脈粥狀硬化的Apoe基因剔除小鼠（Apoe$^{-/-}$小鼠），分成睡眠完整組（SC）及睡眠片段化組（SF）兩個做實驗。實驗結果顯示，與SC相比，SF發生了動脈粥狀硬化病徵，並在動脈中發現大量的Ly-6C$^{\mathrm{high}}$單核球及嗜中性白血球；但是B細胞及其他淋巴球的數量並沒有明顯改變，也沒有體重增加的現象。另外，由下視丘產生的食慾素（hypocretin，縮寫為Hcrt）也在SF發現減少的現象，但輔助Hcrt的傳遞物dynorphin則在SF無差異性的表現。若給予SF小鼠完整睡眠後，這些小鼠又可以產生Hcrt，並且具有正常數量的Ly-6C$^{\mathrm{high}}$單核球及嗜中性白血球。另一個實驗中，在高脂飼料餵食下，同時剔除雙基因的Apoe$^{-/-}$Hcrt$^{-/-}$小鼠的動脈粥狀硬化病徵及Ly-6C$^{\mathrm{high}}$單核球與嗜中性白血球數量增加，會比剔除單基因的Apoe$^{-/-}$小鼠更為嚴重。研究顯示充分的睡眠是有助於維持心血管健康的作用機制。依照上文及所習得知識，回答下列問題。

Reading 2: Questions 39–41 form a group.

CRISPR gene editing is a new technology developed in recent years that can precisely edit or mutate a specific position of a gene, unlike the traditional random mutation using chemical agents. CRISPR technology sends a complex of Cas9 protein and guide RNA (gRNA) (Cas9-gRNA) into the cytoplasm; this complex then enters the nucleus, where the gRNA guides the complex to find DNA that can pair with the gRNA sequence and pairs with it (as shown in Figure 11). Cas9 cuts in the paired region, causing a break in the DNA at that position. The cell's DNA repair mechanism repairs the broken DNA, forming nucleotide deletions or insertions in the gene and thus causing DNA mutations.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/biology-olympiads-bank/main/images/twbio-2019-1-fig11.png

Figure labels (Chinese → English): 切割點 → cleavage site; 染色體 DNA → chromosomal DNA; DNA 修復酶 → DNA repair enzyme; 缺失突變 → deletion mutation; 插入突變 → insertion mutation

The core technique of CRISPR is the preparation of the gRNA molecule, a sequence made up of 20 nucleotides whose purpose is to pair specifically with the DNA to be edited. Given this property, whichever gene scientists want to mutate, they can design the complementary nucleotide sequence of that gene onto the gRNA molecule. The gRNA can then guide the Cas9-gRNA complex to mutate and edit that gene. Gene editing plays an important role in biotechnology, for example by modifying the DNA encoding the active region of an enzyme to improve its catalytic activity.

39. Which of the following statements about mutations caused by CRISPR gene editing are correct?

(A) It may produce new biological characteristics or cause a trait to disappear, and this can be inherited by the offspring

(B) CRISPR gene editing takes place in the cytoplasm

(C) Pairing of the gRNA with the DNA sequence is the key that determines how Cas9 precisely finds the target gene

(D) Cas9 is a nuclease

(E) CRISPR technology needs no help from any cellular enzymes
problems.problem_orig:
[多選題]

閱讀二

CRISPR基因編輯是近年來所發展出來的新技術，可以精準編輯或突變某基因的特定位置，有別於傳統上使用藥劑進行的隨機突變。CRISPR技術將Cas9蛋白及嚮導RNA（gRNA）之複合體（Cas9-gRNA）送入細胞質，然後此複合體會再進入細胞核，由gRNA引導該複合體，找到可以與gRNA序列相配對的DNA進行配對（如圖11所示）。Cas9會在所配對的區域進行切割，造成該位置的DNA斷裂。細胞DNA修補機制會對斷裂的DNA進行修復，形成基因的核苷酸缺失或插入，因而導致DNA突變。

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/biology-olympiads-bank/main/images/twbio-2019-1-fig11.png

CRISPR的核心技術製備gRNA分子，它是由20個核苷酸所組成的序列，目的是與要編輯的DNA進行專一性配對。據此特性，科學家若想要突變哪一個基因，就可以將該基因的互補核苷酸序列設計在gRNA分子上。然後gRNA就可以引導Cas9-gRNA複合體進行該基因的突變與編輯。基因編輯在生物科技上扮演重要的角色，例如針對酵素活性區域之DNA編碼進行改造，提升酵素催化活性。

39. 下列有關CRISPR基因編輯所造成的突變敘述，哪些正確？

(A)可能產生新的生物特性或導致性狀消失，並可以遺傳給後代

(B) CRISPR基因編輯發生在細胞質

(C) gRNA與DNA序列配對是決定Cas9精準找到目標基因的關鍵

(D) Cas9是一種核酸酶

(E) CRISPR技術無需任何細胞酵素的協助

CRISPR gene editing is a new technology developed in recent years that can precisely edit or mutate a specific position of a gene, unlike the traditional random mutation using chemical agents. CRISPR technology sends a complex of Cas9 protein and guide RNA (gRNA) (Cas9-gRNA) into the cytoplasm; this complex then enters the nucleus, where the gRNA guides the complex to find DNA that can pair with the gRNA sequence and pairs with it (as shown in Figure 11). Cas9 cuts in the paired region, causing a break in the DNA at that position. The cell's DNA repair mechanism repairs the broken DNA, forming nucleotide deletions or insertions in the gene and thus causing DNA mutations.

Given this property, whichever gene scientists want to mutate, they can design the complementary nucleotide sequence of that gene onto the gRNA molecule. The gRNA can then guide the Cas9-gRNA complex to mutate and edit that gene. Gene editing plays an important role in biotechnology, for example by modifying the DNA encoding the active region of an enzyme to improve its catalytic activity.

Reading 3: Questions 42–43 form a group.

Wild waterfowl are the natural hosts of influenza A viruses. The avian influenza virus (H1N1), which is shared by humans and birds, infects humans or birds by binding, through the hemagglutinin glycoprotein (HA) on the virus surface, to the sialic acid receptor on the host cell membrane. The sialic acid receptors of human respiratory epithelial cells differ slightly from the receptors of birds, and the binding ability of the HA on the virus surface to the sialic acid receptors of human epithelial cells is the key to whether an avian influenza virus infects humans.

Bats are excellent hosts of influenza viruses. Scientists collected two new strains of influenza A virus (H17N10 and H18N11) from bats in Central and South America. Interestingly, the HA on the surface of these two strains does not bind to the sialic acid receptor on the host cell membrane; instead, the HA on the influenza virus surface binds to the major histocompatibility complex class II (MHC-II) of the host cell membrane to enter the cell and thereby infect the host. Scientists also found that bat influenza viruses can bind to the MHC-II of humans, mice, pigs and chickens, and can infect humans not only directly but also through livestock. These research results help us carry out risk assessment of the zoonotic transmissibility of bat influenza viruses. Based on the text above and related knowledge, answer the following questions.

野生水鳥是A型流感病毒的天然寄主。人禽共通的禽流感病毒（H1N1）透過病毒表面的血球凝集素醣蛋白（HA）與寄主細胞膜上的唾液酸受體（sialic acid receptor）結合而感染人或鳥類。人類呼吸道上皮細胞的唾液酸受體和鳥類的受體上有些許差異，而病毒表面的HA和人類上皮細胞的唾液酸受體之結合能力大小，是禽流感病毒是否感染人類的關鍵。

蝙蝠是甚佳的流感病毒寄主，科學家在中南美洲蝙蝠身上採到兩株新的A型流感病毒（H17N10與H18N11），有趣的是這兩株病毒表面的HA不會和寄主細胞膜上唾液酸受體結合，而是透過流感病毒表面的HA和寄主細胞膜的第二型主要組織相容性複體（MHC-II）結合進入細胞，進而感染宿主。科學家也發現蝙蝠流感病毒可與人類、小鼠、豬及雞的MHC-II結合，不僅可以直接感染人類，也可以透過家畜感染人類。這些研究成果有助於我們對蝙蝠流感病毒的人畜共通傳染性進行風險評估。根據上文所述及相關知識，回答下列問題。

[Single choice]

Questions 18–19 form a group.

The Tang poet Du Fu wrote: "Beacon fires have burned for three months in succession; a letter from home is worth ten thousand pieces of gold." In a vast ancient empire, important messages could be transmitted quickly and efficiently by lighting beacon fires on beacon towers far apart from each other. This is like the saltatory conduction of action potentials along a myelinated nerve fiber. The beacon fire on a beacon tower of the nerve fiber (that is, the action potential) flashes on quickly like a spark from a flint (that is, depolarization) and goes out quickly (that is, repolarization), so multiple action potentials can be produced instantly at a beacon tower; by weaving action potentials of different frequencies and numbers, rich and varied messages can leap from tower to tower like the compiling of Morse code. Based on the above information and what you have learned, answer the following questions.

18. If the action potential is likened to the beacon fire, which of the following structures best represents the beacon tower?

(A) The dendrites of a neuron

(B) The myelin sheath wrapped around an axon

(C) The nodes of Ranvier of a myelinated axon

(D) The synapses between neurons

18-19題為題組

杜甫詩「烽火連三月，家書抵萬金」。在幅員廣大的古帝國，藉由點燃相距遙遠的烽火台上的烽火，可迅速有效率地傳遞重要訊息。這好比具髓鞘神經纖維上動作電位的跳躍式傳導。神經纖維烽火台上的烽火（即動作電位）如電光火石般快閃（即去極化）與快滅（即再極化），故烽火台上可瞬間產生多次的動作電位，藉由編織不同頻率與數目的動作電位，豐富多樣的訊息即可如編輯摩斯密碼般在烽火台間跳躍傳遞。依上述資訊與習得的知識，回答下列問題。

Reading 1: Questions 36–38 form a group.

Lymphatic vessels, formed by an arrangement of lymphatic endothelial cells (LECs for short), are very important for body fluid homeostasis, immune responses, lipid transport and the regulation of health. Excessive lymphatic vessel formation favors cancer metastasis and inflammation, whereas insufficient lymphatic vessel formation leads to lymphedema. In 2017, scientists found that an important metabolic pathway involved in the development of lymphatic vessels is fatty acid β-oxidation; after a series of reactions in which fatty acids are oxidatively broken down, an important metabolite, acetyl CoA, is finally produced and enters the TCA cycle. Using transgenic mice for observation, scientists found that if LECs carry out fatty acid β-oxidation without the participation of the rate-controlling enzyme CPT1A, lymphatic vessel development is impaired; later it was further found that the transcription factor PROX1 can promote the expression of CPT1A and thereby increase the production of acetyl CoA. Because the histone acetyltransferase p300 (p300 for short) can use acetyl CoA to cause acetylation of the histones of lymphatic-vessel-formation genes, and thereby increase the expression of these genes, and this acetylation of histones in specific regions is brought about by the interaction of p300 with PROX1. In this study, scientists demonstrated that metabolites have the property of regulating lymphatic vessel development; in the future, diseases caused by an imbalance of lymphatic vessel formation may be ameliorated through dietary regulation of fatty acids or supplementation with metabolites. Based on the above text and what you have learned, answer Questions 36–38.

36. Which of the following statements about lymphatic vessel formation is correct?

(A) Fatty acid β-oxidation is inhibited

(B) LECs cannot carry out fatty acid β-oxidation

(C) p300 affects the expression of lymphatic-vessel-formation genes in the cytoplasm

(D) Metabolites can influence lymphatic vessel formation

閱讀一

由淋巴內皮細胞（簡稱LECs）排列所組成的淋巴管，對於體液恆定、免疫反應、脂質運送以及健康調控相當重要。過多的淋巴管生成有利於癌症轉移和發炎，而淋巴管生成不足則會導致淋巴水腫。2017年，科學家發現，參與淋巴管發育過程的重要代謝路徑是脂肪酸β-氧化作用（fatty acid β-oxidation），在脂肪酸氧化分解的一系列反應後，最終會產生重要的代謝物－乙醯輔酶A（acetyl CoA），進入TCA循環。科學家利用基因轉殖的小鼠進行觀察，發現若LECs進行脂肪酸β-氧化作用，若無速率控制酶CPT1A參與，將會損害淋巴管發育；其後更發現，轉錄因子PROX1可以促進CPT1A的表現，進而增加乙醯輔酶A的產量。由於組蛋白乙醯轉移酶p300（簡稱p300）可利用乙醯輔酶A，造成淋巴管生成基因的組蛋白（histone）乙醯化，進而可以增加淋巴管生成基因的表現，且此種特定區域組蛋白乙醯化的現象是由p300與PROX1相互作用而促成的。在這研究中，科學家證明代謝物具有調節淋巴管發育的特性，未來或許可藉由脂肪酸的膳食調節或補充代謝物來改善淋巴管生成失衡所引起的疾病。依據上文內容和習得的知識，回答第36-38題。

36. 下列對於淋巴管生成的相關敘述，何者正確？

(A) 脂肪酸β-氧化作用會被抑制

[Single choice]

Reading 1: Questions 36–38 form a group.

Lymphatic vessels, formed by an arrangement of lymphatic endothelial cells (LECs for short), are very important for body fluid homeostasis, immune responses, lipid transport and the regulation of health. Excessive lymphatic vessel formation favors cancer metastasis and inflammation, whereas insufficient lymphatic vessel formation leads to lymphedema. In 2017, scientists found that an important metabolic pathway involved in the development of lymphatic vessels is fatty acid β-oxidation; after a series of reactions in which fatty acids are oxidatively broken down, an important metabolite, acetyl CoA, is finally produced and enters the TCA cycle. Using transgenic mice for observation, scientists found that if LECs carry out fatty acid β-oxidation without the participation of the rate-controlling enzyme CPT1A, lymphatic vessel development is impaired; later it was further found that the transcription factor PROX1 can promote the expression of CPT1A and thereby increase the production of acetyl CoA. Because the histone acetyltransferase p300 (p300 for short) can use acetyl CoA to cause acetylation of the histones of lymphatic-vessel-formation genes, and thereby increase the expression of these genes, and this acetylation of histones in specific regions is brought about by the interaction of p300 with PROX1. In this study, scientists demonstrated that metabolites have the property of regulating lymphatic vessel development; in the future, diseases caused by an imbalance of lymphatic vessel formation may be ameliorated through dietary regulation of fatty acids or supplementation with metabolites. (A) The chance of lymphedema

(B) The chance of inflammation

(C) The expression of the p300 gene

(D) The production of acetyl CoA

由淋巴內皮細胞（簡稱LECs）排列所組成的淋巴管，對於體液恆定、免疫反應、脂質運送以及健康調控相當重要。過多的淋巴管生成有利於癌症轉移和發炎，而淋巴管生成不足則會導致淋巴水腫。2017年，科學家發現，參與淋巴管發育過程的重要代謝路徑是脂肪酸β-氧化作用（fatty acid β-oxidation），在脂肪酸氧化分解的一系列反應後，最終會產生重要的代謝物－乙醯輔酶A（acetyl CoA），進入TCA循環。科學家利用基因轉殖的小鼠進行觀察，發現若LECs進行脂肪酸β-氧化作用，若無速率控制酶CPT1A參與，將會損害淋巴管發育；其後更發現，轉錄因子PROX1可以促進CPT1A的表現，進而增加乙醯輔酶A的產量。由於組蛋白乙醯轉移酶p300（簡稱p300）可利用乙醯輔酶A，造成淋巴管生成基因的組蛋白（histone）乙醯化，進而可以增加淋巴管生成基因的表現，且此種特定區域組蛋白乙醯化的現象是由p300與PROX1相互作用而促成的。在這研究中，科學家證明代謝物具有調節淋巴管發育的特性，未來或許可藉由脂肪酸的膳食調節或補充代謝物來改善淋巴管生成失衡所引起的疾病。依據上文內容和習得的知識，回答第36-38題。

Reading 2: Questions 39–40 form a group.

Blue roses do not exist in nature. In 2004, scientists in Japan and Australia used RNA interference (RNAi) technology to successfully reduce the expression of the flavanone (dihydroflavonol) enzyme (DFR) gene in rose flowers, and at the same time transferred in "an enzyme gene that can promote the production of the bright blue delphinidin", thereby creating a blue rose variety. This RNA interference technology transfers a gene fragment of the DFR gene into the rose to produce double-stranded RNA; this double-stranded RNA is transmissible and can move effectively between tissues, and then produces small interfering RNA (siRNA for short); the siRNA then forms RISC with several proteins, and RISC can further form complementary pairing with the DFR mRNA and cut this mRNA, so that the DFR protein cannot be expressed, which is gene silencing. When the DFR gene is silenced, the amount of anthocyanins of other colors synthesized decreases, and with the accumulation of delphinidin, a blue flower color is produced. Based on the above text and what you have learned, answer the following questions.

39. RNA interference technology mainly prevents which step of the expression of the target gene from taking place?

(A) Transcription

(B) Translation

(C) Post-translational modification

(D) Binding of the promoter

自然界並不存在藍色的玫瑰。2004年，日本與澳洲的科學家利用RNA干擾（RNA interference, RNAi）技術，成功使玫瑰花的黃烷酮醇酵素（簡稱DFR）基因的表現量下降，並同時轉殖入「能促使鮮藍色翠雀花素（Delphinidin）產生的酵素基因」，因而創造了藍玫瑰品種。這項RNA干擾技術是將基因DFR 的基因片段轉殖入玫瑰，以產生雙股RNA；這雙股RNA具有傳遞性，可以有效地在組織間移動，進而產生小片段的干擾RNA（簡稱siRNA），siRNA再與多個蛋白質形成RISC，RISC可進一步與DFR mRNA形成互補作用並切斷此mRNA，導致無法表現DFR蛋白質，即基因靜默。當基因DFR 靜默時，其他顏色的花青素合成量會減少，而在翠雀花素累積的情形下，產生藍色的花色。依上文所述及習得的知識，回答下列問題。

39. RNA干擾的技術，主要是造成目標基因表現的哪一步驟無法進行？

(B) 轉譯

[Single choice]

Reading 3: Questions 41–43 form a group.

The somatosensory system transmits signals of touch, pain, itch and so on to the brain, and is extremely important for spatial perception and communication. However, under abnormal conditions, ordinary mechanical stimuli can trigger abnormal sensations, such as alloknesis (itch evoked by touch); the related mechanism is still unknown. Artificial fibers that exert a force equivalent to 0.02–0.16 g on contact were used to mechanically stimulate the skin of mice, causing them to produce tactile responses. The study found that aged mice display scratching behavior, whereas young mice show no scratching behavior. However, when a pruritogen (such as histamine) is given, there is no significant difference in the number of scratches between young and aged mice. When an artificial fiber with a force of 2 g, sufficient to cause mechanical pain, is used for stimulation instead, there is no difference between the responses of young and aged mice. Tissue staining analysis showed that the number of Merkel touch receptor cells (MCs for short) in the epidermal tissue of aged mice is reduced. Reducing the number of MCs in the epidermal tissue of young mice by gene deletion or chemical damage results in alloknesis. MCs can express a mechanically gated cation channel called Piezo2; after the Piezo2 channel is activated by mechanical stimulation, it can cause depolarization of the MC cell membrane and then trigger the release of neurotransmitters. Interestingly, when the expression of Piezo2 is knocked out by genetic engineering techniques, the experimental animals also clearly develop alloknesis. Based on the above text and what you have learned, answer Questions 41–43.

41. According to the text, which of the following conclusions is correct?

(A) Histamine can activate the MC receptors of the skin

(B) The types of pain receptors differ between young skin and aged skin

(C) Aging affects the sensitivity of the skin in converting mechanical touch into itch

(D) Artificial fibers of 0.02 g and 2 g can both activate all types of touch receptors

[單選題]

閱讀三

體感系統傳遞觸覺、疼痛和癢等訊號到大腦，對空間察覺和傳達極為重要。然而在異常狀態下，一般的機械性刺激會引發異常感覺，如異癢症；然相關機制仍不知。利用碰觸時會施加相當0.02-0.16 g力量的人造纖維對老鼠皮膚做機械刺激，使牠產生觸覺反應。研究發現，老年老鼠會表現抓癢的行為，但年輕老鼠並無抓癢行為。但是給予致癢素（如組織胺），年輕老鼠和老年老鼠搔癢次數沒有顯著差異。當改以足以造成機械性痛覺的2 g力量的人造纖維做刺激，則年輕老鼠和老年老鼠反應並沒有差別。利用組織染色分析顯示，老年鼠表皮組織的Merkel氏觸覺受器細胞（簡稱MC）數量減少。以基因刪除或化學傷害方式減低年輕老鼠表皮組織的MC數量，會造成異癢症的現象。MC可表現一種稱為Piezo2的機械性閘控正離子通道，Piezo2通道受機械性刺激活化後，可以引起MC細胞膜去極化，進而觸發神經傳導物質的釋放。有趣的是，利用基因工程技術剔除Piezo2的表現，實驗動物也明顯產生異癢現象。依據上文內容和習得的知識，回答第41-43題。

(A) 組織胺能活化皮膚的MC受器

(B) 年輕皮膚和老化皮膚痛覺受器種類不同

(C) 老化使皮膚對機械性觸覺轉化成發癢的敏感度

(D) 0.02與2 g的人造纖維皆能活化所有種類的觸覺受器

體感系統傳遞觸覺、疼痛和癢等訊號到大腦，對空間察覺和傳達極為重要。然而在異常狀態下，一般的機械性刺激會引發異常感覺，如異癢症；然相關機制仍不知。利用碰觸時會施加相當0.02-0.16 g力量的人造纖維對老鼠皮膚做機械刺激，使牠產生觸覺反應。研究發現，老年老鼠會表現抓癢的行為，但年輕老鼠並無抓癢行為。但是給予致癢素（如組織胺），年輕老鼠和老年老鼠搔癢次數沒有顯著差異。當改以足以造成機械性痛覺的2 g力量的人造纖維做刺激，則年輕老鼠和老年老鼠反應並沒有差別。利用組織染色分析顯示，老年鼠表皮組織的Merkel氏觸覺受器細胞（簡稱MC）數量減少。以基因刪除或化學傷害方式減低年輕老鼠表皮組織的MC數量，會造成異癢症的現象。MC可表現一種稱為Piezo2的機械性閘控正離子通道，Piezo2通道受機械性刺激活化後，可以引起MC細胞膜去極化，進而觸發神經傳導物質的釋放。有趣的是，利用基因工程技術剔除Piezo2的表現，實驗動物也明顯產生異癢現象。依據上文內容和習得的知識，回答第41-43題。

[Single choice]

Reading 1: Questions 36–38 form a group.

In 1897, Yan Fu's translation of Thomas Henry Huxley's Evolution and Ethics (Tian Yan Lun) mentioned: "Bees have a queen; the queen bee is female, hence she is called the queen. Her subjects: the males are idle, while the workers are for the most part female. Those who gather flowers and make honey are all female and neither mate nor bear young; the males do nothing, and are commonly mistaken for females and called 'bee sisters'. Within one hive, provisions are given by head count, and each performs its duty."

In 1845, the Polish priest Johann Dzierzon proposed that drones have no father and develop directly from unfertilized eggs, whereas female bees develop from fertilized eggs. Later studies confirmed that drones have half as many genes as female bees. Yet for the following 150 years, scientists did not know which gene controls the sex of bees. Not until 2003 did the German scientist Martin Beye and colleagues isolate a bee gene called complementary sex determiner (CSD for short); the number of copies of CSD determines the sex of a bee: two copies give a female, one copy gives a male. When the CSD of a fertilized egg has two different alleles, both alleles are activated and together produce an active protein, which induces the fertilized egg to develop into a female; a female bee then develops further into a worker bee or a new queen according to the needs of the bee colony. However, an individual that develops from a fertilized egg carrying a pair of identical CSD alleles is removed by the worker bees. Because an unfertilized egg has only one CSD allele and cannot synthesize the active protein, the egg develops into a drone after maturing. Drones are larger than worker bees and eat more, so the worker bees decide whether to keep the drones according to the needs of reproduction and the amount of food. Based on the above text and what you have learned, answer the following questions.

36. According to the passage, which of the following is correct?

(A) The queen bee has one set of chromosomes

(B) The "bee sister" has two sets of chromosomes

(C) The idle bee that is male and does nothing has one set of chromosomes

(D) The "ones who gather flowers and make honey" have one set of chromosomes

閱讀一

1897年嚴復譯自托馬斯‧亨利‧赫胥黎的《天演論》提及：「夫蜂有后，蜂王雌故曰后。其民雄者惰，而操作者半雌。採花釀蜜者皆雌而不交不孕，其雄不事事，俗誤為雌，呼曰蜂姐。一壺之內，計口而稟，各致其職。」。

1845年波蘭牧師約翰‧德濟宗提出，雄蜂無父且由未受精的卵直接發育，雌蜂才是從受精卵發育而來。後來的研究證實，雄蜂的基因數量為雌蜂的一半。然此之後150年來，科學家一直不知道控制蜜蜂性別的基因為何。直至2003年，德國科學家馬丁‧比耶等人分離出一種稱為互補性決定子（簡稱CSD）的蜜蜂基因，CSD的套數可決定蜜蜂性別：雙套為雌，單套為雄。若受精卵的CSD具有兩個不同型的等位基因時，兩個等位基因皆被活化合力製造出一種具有活性的蛋白質，能誘使受精卵發育成雌性；雌蜂則會按蜜蜂家族的需求進一步發育成工蜂或新蜂后。但是帶有一對同型CSD的受精卵，發育後的個體會被工蜂移除。由於未受精的卵僅有一個等位基因CSD，無法合成有活性的蛋白質，因此卵成熟後發育為雄蜂。雄蜂體型較工蜂大，食量也大，因此工蜂會根據繁殖的需要和食物的多寡來決定雄蜂去留。依上文及所習得的知識，回答下列問題。

36. 根據文章敘述，下列何者正確？

(A)蜂后的染色體套數為單套

(B)蜂姐的染色體套數為雙套

(C)雄而不事的惰蜂染色體為單套

(D)「採花釀蜜者」的染色體套數為單套

1845年波蘭牧師約翰‧德濟宗提出，雄蜂無父且由未受精的卵直接發育，雌蜂才是從受精卵發育而來。後來的研究證實，雄蜂的基因數量為雌蜂的一半。然此之後150年來，科學家一直不知道控制蜜蜂性別的基因為何。直至2003年，德國科學家馬丁‧比耶等人分離出一種稱為互補性決定子（簡稱CSD）的蜜蜂基因，CSD的套數可決定蜜蜂性別：雙套為雌，單套為雄。若受精卵的CSD具有兩個不同型的等位基因時，兩個等位基因皆被活化合力製造出一種具有活性的蛋白質，能誘使受精卵發育成雌性；雌蜂則會按蜜蜂家族的需求進一步發育成工蜂或新蜂后。但是帶有一對同型CSD的受精卵，發育後的個體會被工蜂移除。由於未受精的卵僅有一個等位基因CSD，無法合成有活性的蛋白質，因此卵成熟後發育為雄蜂。雄蜂體型較工蜂大，食量也大，因此工蜂會根據繁殖的需要和食物的多寡來決定雄蜂去留。依上文及所習得的知識，回答下列問題。

37. 研究人員利用分子生物技術來阻斷卵的CSD活性，推測可能會發生什麼事？

(A)卵受精後發育為雄性

(B)卵受精後發育為雌性

(C)卵受精後變成單倍體

(D)卵不受精發育為雄性

(E)卵不受精發育為雌性

Reading 1: Questions 36–38 form a group.

In 1897, Yan Fu's translation of Thomas Henry Huxley's Evolution and Ethics (Tian Yan Lun) mentioned: "Bees have a queen; the queen bee is female, hence she is called the queen. Her subjects: the males are idle, while the workers are for the most part female. Those who gather flowers and make honey are all female and neither mate nor bear young; the males do nothing, and are commonly mistaken for females and called 'bee sisters'. Within one hive, provisions are given by head count, and each performs its duty."

In 1845, the Polish priest Johann Dzierzon proposed that drones have no father and develop directly from unfertilized eggs, whereas female bees develop from fertilized eggs. Later studies confirmed that drones have half as many genes as female bees. Yet for the following 150 years, scientists did not know which gene controls the sex of bees. Not until 2003 did the German scientist Martin Beye and colleagues isolate a bee gene called complementary sex determiner (CSD for short); the number of copies of CSD determines the sex of a bee: two copies give a female, one copy gives a male. When the CSD of a fertilized egg has two different alleles, both alleles are activated and together produce an active protein, which induces the fertilized egg to develop into a female; a female bee then develops further into a worker bee or a new queen according to the needs of the bee colony. However, an individual that develops from a fertilized egg carrying a pair of identical CSD alleles is removed by the worker bees. Because an unfertilized egg has only one CSD allele and cannot synthesize the active protein, the egg develops into a drone after maturing. Drones are larger than worker bees and eat more, so the worker bees decide whether to keep the drones according to the needs of reproduction and the amount of food. Based on the above text and what you have learned, answer the following questions.

38. During cell division in a drone, the behavior of the chromosomes is most similar to which of the following situations?

(A) A male ant in the natural environment

(B) A man with Klinefelter syndrome, with sex chromosomes XXY

(C) An individual with cri-du-chat syndrome, in which a chromosome has a deletion

(D) A plant host cell with T-DNA inserted

Reading 2: Questions 39–40 form a group.

The moth orchid (Phalaenopsis) is one of Taiwan's important export flower crops. It is a plant with crassulacean acid metabolism (CAM), and Taiwan currently uses asexual propagation techniques to raise mature plants rapidly. Considering cost, in sea shipping many plants are usually packed tightly together in a container and transported in the dark for about 25 days, but during this time the plants are prone to deterioration, such as leaf senescence, bud-sheath drop and bud abortion. In the moth orchid, vegetative growth and reproductive growth inhibit each other; if it is grown at high temperature all the time, the plant cannot bolt (produce a flower stalk), and flowering must be induced by low temperature. On the other hand, the light intensity before bolting has a great effect on the rate of bolting; during low-temperature flower induction, if the light intensity is too weak or there is darkness, not only is the number of flowers reduced, but the flowering period is also delayed.

In addition, Taiwan collaborated internationally on the Phalaenopsis equestris orchid of Xiaolanyu (Little Orchid Island), using the Illumina HiSeq 2000 platform to sequence its genome in 2014, making it the first orchid-family (Orchidaceae) plant in the world to have its whole genome sequenced. The size of the assembled genome of Phalaenopsis equestris is $1.16 \times 10^{9}$ nucleotide base pairs (bp), and it is estimated that 29,431 genes can be translated into proteins. From the whole-genome sequencing results, it was found that Phalaenopsis equestris has a larger number and greater diversity of gene families such as MADS-box C/D-class, B-class AP3 and AGL6-class. The expansion of these gene families may be the main reason why the flowers of orchids differ in morphology from those of other plants. Based on the above text and what you have learned, answer the following questions.

39. According to the text above, which of the following inferences are correct?

(A) The deterioration that occurs during storage and transport for export of moth orchids may be caused by ethylene

(B) Because the darkness of long-term storage and transport affects flowering, it is best to wait until the flowers are in full bloom before transporting them

(C) Tissue culture technology can serve as a means of rapidly raising moth orchid plants while maintaining quality

(D) Low temperature can induce flowering, so when exporting moth orchids it is best to transport them stored at 4℃

(E) Temperature and light are the most important factors regulating the flowering period of moth orchids

閱讀二

蝴蝶蘭是臺灣重要出口花卉作物之一，屬於景天酸代謝（CAM）的植物，目前臺灣利用無性繁殖技術，快速培育成熟株。因考量成本，海運時，通常以多株植株緊密排列後裝箱，在黑暗下運輸約25日，但期間植株容易發生腐損，如葉片老化、落苞、消蕾等。蝴蝶蘭的營養生長與生殖生長相互抑制作用，如果一直在高溫下栽培，植株無法抽梗，必須低溫誘導開花。另一方面，抽梗前的光照度對抽梗速率影響很大，低溫催花時，若光照度過弱或黑暗，不但會導致花朵數減少，也會使開花期延遲。

另外，臺灣與國際合作，以小蘭嶼蝴蝶蘭（Phalaenopsis equestris）為標的，利用Illumina HiSeq 2000平台，於2014年將其基因體解序，成為全世界第一個全基因體解序的蘭科植物。小蘭嶼蝴蝶蘭基因體組裝後的大小為$1.16 \times 10^{9}$核苷酸鹼基對（bp），預估有29,431個基因可轉譯成蛋白質。經由全基因體解序的結果，發現小蘭嶼蝴蝶蘭具有較多且多樣性的MADS-box C／D群（MADS-box C／D-class）、B群AP3（B-class AP3）以及AGL6群（AGL6-class）等基因家族。這些基因家族的擴張，可能是造成蘭科植物和其他植物的花形態不同的主要原因。依上文及所習得的知識，回答下列問題。

39. 根據上文，下列推論哪些正確？

(A)蝴蝶蘭外銷儲運時所發生的腐損原因可能是乙烯造成的

(B)因為長時間儲運的黑暗會影響開花，所以最好是等花盛開之後再運輸

(C)組織培養技術可作為快速培育蝴蝶蘭植株並維持品質的手段

(D)低溫可以誘導開花，所以在蝴蝶蘭外銷時，最好採4℃保存方式運輸

(E)溫度和光照是調節蝴蝶蘭花期最重要的因素

Reading 3: Questions 41–43 form a group.

Glutamate is the main excitatory neurotransmitter in the brain, and most excitatory synapses in the brain use glutamate as their neurotransmitter. However, glutamate is also one of the powerful killers that poison nerve cells. Excitotoxicity refers to the over-activation of the glutamate receptors of nerve cells, especially NMDA-type receptors, when extracellular glutamate exceeds its normal concentration, so that a large amount of calcium ions enters the cells; this puts the nerve cells in a state of extreme excitation and under extremely high metabolic stress, and they then begin to die, which may happen during a stroke. During a stroke, nerve cells cannot obtain enough energy and therefore cannot maintain their normal membrane potential; that is, the cell membrane begins to depolarize, which causes the nerve endings to secrete glutamate, which then immediately begins to excite other nerve cells in the brain; the excited nerve cells in turn secrete more glutamate, so that nerve cells are further excited and secrete still more glutamate; in this vicious circle the extracellular glutamate concentration finally becomes too high, causing the death of many nerve cells and resulting in excitotoxicity. Besides genetic factors, excitotoxicity is also thought to be one of the possible causes of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS, also called motor neuron disease). In the past, the indigenous people of Guam were fond of eating a native plant rich in the excitotoxin $\beta$-methylamino-L-alanine ($\beta$-MA for short); $\beta$-MA can bind to and activate glutamate receptors, thereby causing excitotoxicity, so that those who ate it showed symptoms resembling those of ALS, which became a characteristic disease frequently occurring in that population. After the residents were taught to stop eating these plants, this disease has rarely occurred again in Guam.

41. What is the main content that this passage expounds?

(A) The causes and treatment of ALS

(B) The occurrence of excitotoxicity and the functioning of nerves

(C) Glutamate and excitatory synaptic transmission

(D) Nutrition and diseases of the nervous system

麩胺酸是腦中主要的興奮性神經傳導物質，腦中大部分的興奮性突觸都以麩胺酸為神經傳導物質。然而麩胺酸也是毒害神經細胞的厲害殺手之一。興奮性毒害（excitotoxicity）是指胞外麩胺酸超過正常濃度下，神經細胞的麩胺酸受器被過度活化，特別是NMDA型受器，使大量鈣離子進入細胞內，導致神經細胞處於極度興奮狀態與極高代謝壓力之下，進而開始產生死亡，中風時就可能發生這種情形。中風時，神經細胞會因為無法獲取足夠的能量，而不能維持其正常膜電位，也就是細胞膜會開始產生去極化，促使神經末梢分泌麩胺酸，隨即開始興奮大腦中的其他神經細胞，受興奮的神經細胞又再分泌更多的麩胺酸，造成神經細胞進一步的被興奮並分泌更多的麩胺酸，如此惡性循環，最終使得胞外麩胺酸濃度過高，導致許多神經細胞死亡，造成興奮性毒害。除遺傳因素外，興奮性毒害也被認為是造成漸凍人疾病（簡稱ALS）的可能原因之一。過去，關島的原住民嗜食一種富含興奮性毒素$\beta$-甲基氨基丙氨酸（簡稱$\beta$-MA）的原生植物，$\beta$-MA能接合並活化麩胺酸受器，進而引起興奮性毒害，導致食用者出現的症狀如ALS病徵，成為該族群常發生的一種特有疾病。經教導居民停止攝取這些植物後，這項疾病在關島已鮮少再發生。

(A)ALS的致病原因與治療

(B)興奮性毒害的產生與神經的運作

(C)麩胺酸與興奮性突觸傳導

(D)營養學與神經系統疾病

麩胺酸是腦中主要的興奮性神經傳導物質，腦中大部分的興奮性突觸都以麩胺酸為神經傳導物質。然而麩胺酸也是毒害神經細胞的厲害殺手之一。興奮性毒害（excitotoxicity）是指胞外麩胺酸超過正常濃度下，神經細胞的麩胺酸受器被過度活化，特別是NMDA型受器，使大量鈣離子進入細胞內，導致神經細胞處於極度興奮狀態與極高代謝壓力之下，進而開始產生死亡，中風時就可能發生這種情形。中風時，神經細胞會因為無法獲取足夠的能量，而不能維持其正常膜電位，也就是細胞膜會開始產生去極化，促使神經末梢分泌麩胺酸，隨即開始興奮大腦中的其他神經細胞，受興奮的神經細胞又再分泌更多的麩胺酸，造成神經細胞進一步的被興奮並分泌更多的麩胺酸，如此惡性循環，最終使得胞外麩胺酸濃度過高，導致許多神經細胞死亡，造成興奮性毒害。除遺傳因素外，興奮性毒害也被認為是造成漸凍人疾病（簡稱ALS）的可能原因之一。過去，關島的原住民嗜食一種富含興奮性毒素$\beta$-甲基氨基丙氨酸（簡稱$\beta$-MA）的原生植物，$\beta$-MA能接合並活化麩胺酸受器，進而引起興奮性毒害，導致食用者出現的症狀如ALS病徵，成為該族群常發生的一種特有疾病。經教導居民停止攝取這些植物後，這項疾病在關島已鮮少再發生。

42. 由本文推測，下列哪些作法可能降低中風病人神經細胞的傷害？

(A)給予能減緩麩胺酸分泌的藥物

(B)給予能減低NMDA受器功能的藥物

(C)給予能促進興奮性突觸傳導的藥物

(D)給予能迅速清除胞外麩胺酸濃度的藥物

(E)給予鈣片迅速補充鈣離子

Reading 3: Questions 41–43 form a group.

Glutamate is the main excitatory neurotransmitter in the brain, and most excitatory synapses in the brain use glutamate as their neurotransmitter. However, glutamate is also one of the powerful killers that poison nerve cells. Excitotoxicity refers to the over-activation of the glutamate receptors of nerve cells, especially NMDA-type receptors, when extracellular glutamate exceeds its normal concentration, so that a large amount of calcium ions enters the cells; this puts the nerve cells in a state of extreme excitation and under extremely high metabolic stress, and they then begin to die, which may happen during a stroke. During a stroke, nerve cells cannot obtain enough energy and therefore cannot maintain their normal membrane potential; that is, the cell membrane begins to depolarize, which causes the nerve endings to secrete glutamate, which then immediately begins to excite other nerve cells in the brain; the excited nerve cells in turn secrete more glutamate, so that nerve cells are further excited and secrete still more glutamate; in this vicious circle the extracellular glutamate concentration finally becomes too high, causing the death of many nerve cells and resulting in excitotoxicity. Besides genetic factors, excitotoxicity is also thought to be one of the possible causes of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS, also called motor neuron disease). In the past, the indigenous people of Guam were fond of eating a native plant rich in the excitotoxin $\beta$-methylamino-L-alanine ($\beta$-MA for short); $\beta$-MA can bind to and activate glutamate receptors, thereby causing excitotoxicity, so that those who ate it showed symptoms resembling those of ALS, which became a characteristic disease frequently occurring in that population. After the residents were taught to stop eating these plants, this disease has rarely occurred again in Guam.

43. Which of the following factors may cause excitotoxicity?

(A) Having a stroke

(B) Having ALS

(C) Excessive intake of plants rich in $\beta$-MA

(D) Insufficient intake of protein rich in glutamate

(E) Living on Pacific islands for a long time

The common rapid test reagent applies the principle of immunochromatography, as in Figure 2-A. After the specimen is added to the specimen zone, the molecules in the specimen move toward the absorption zone on the right by capillary action. The antibodies in the colloidal-gold antibody zone (shown as Y shapes in the figure) are already bound to red-purple colloidal gold (shown as circles in the figure); if the specimen contains an antigen that can bind, an "antigen–colloidal-gold antibody complex" is formed. This complex, together with colloidal-gold antibodies that have not bound antigen, can continue to flow to the right and bind to different antibodies on test line 甲 and test line 乙 on the right, giving the test result shown in Figure 2-B.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/biology-olympiads-bank/main/images/twbio-2021-1-fig2.png

Reading 1: Questions 36–38 form a group.

The immune system actively resists infection by microorganisms, while at the same time allowing a large commensal flora to settle in the intestine for the long term. When scientists studied the intestines of healthy people, they found that the living commensal bacteria in faeces are all complexes bound to immunoglobulin A (IgA). How IgA and commensal bacteria interact to enable the bacteria to form stable colonies in the intestine has therefore become a popular research topic in recent years.

Bacteroides fragilis is a dominant bacterium of the human intestine. Scientists found that this bacterium has a genetic locus called commensal colonization factors (ccfABCDE), which forms the CCF system described below. Besides inducing the human body to produce specific IgA that can bind to the commensal bacterium, this system can also regulate the surface configuration of the bacterial cell, so that IgA binds to it through specific immune recognition, thereby promoting bacterial adhesion and colonisation on the intestinal mucosa. When the scientists studied the molecular mechanism by which the surface configuration of the bacterial cell changes, they found that the genes regulated by the CCF system are related to the group of loci for the synthesis and utilisation of the capsular polysaccharides (PS) of Bacteroides fragilis. When the ccfABCDE locus is deleted (△ccf; △ means loss of gene expression), the capsule layer of the mutant strain is not only thinner than that of the wild-type strain (WT), but polysaccharide C (PSC) of the capsule of this mutant is also found to decrease while polysaccharide A (PSA) increases. When the Bacteroides fragilis mutant with PSC synthesis deleted (△PSC) was introduced into mice, the colonisation of this mutant on the rectal mucosa was found to show a significant downward trend compared with the wild-type strain; conversely, when △PSA was introduced into mice, its colonisation was similar to that of the wild-type strain. The above studies show that Bacteroides fragilis, like other commensal strains, requires the IgA response, which excludes foreign competitors and allows the commensal bacteria to colonise specific niches of the intestinal mucosa stably. Therefore, besides its role in clearing pathogens, IgA can also strengthen the host–microbe commensal relationship. Based on the passage above and the knowledge you have learnt, answer Questions 36–38:

(A) T cell

(B) B cell

(C) Mast cell

(D) Macrophage

閱讀一

免疫系統會積極抵抗微生物的感染，同時又允許大量共生菌群長期定居在腸道。科學家研究健康人腸道時，發現在糞便中活的共生菌都是和免疫球蛋白A（IgA）結合的複合體。因此，IgA和共生菌如何交互作用使細菌在腸道形成穩定菌落，是近年來熱門的研究議題。

脆弱擬桿菌（Bacteroides fragilis）是人類腸道優勢菌，科學家發現此菌有一基因座（genetic locus），稱之為共生定殖因子（commensal colonization factors；ccfABCDE），形成下述的CCF系統，此系統除了可誘發人體產生能與共生菌結合的特異性IgA，亦可調節菌體表面構型，使IgA經由特異性免疫辨識與之結合，進而促進細菌黏附和定殖在腸黏膜上。科學家研究菌體表面構型改變的分子機制時，發現CCF系統所調控的基因，是與脆弱擬桿菌莢膜聚醣（polysaccharide;PS）的合成與利用的基因座群（loci）有關。若ccfABCDE基因座有缺失（△ccf；△指基因表現缺失）時，則突變菌株菌體的莢膜層厚度較野生型菌株（WT）薄外，也發現此突變株莢膜的聚醣C（PSC）下降，而聚醣A（PSA）增加。若將PSC合成缺失（△PSC）的脆弱擬桿菌突變株殖入小鼠，發現此突變株在直腸黏膜定殖菌落量比野生型菌株有顯著下降的趨勢；反之若將△PSA殖入小鼠，則其定殖菌落量和野生型菌株相近。以上研究顯示脆弱擬桿菌和其他共生菌株同樣需要IgA的反應，排斥外來的競爭者並使共生菌穩定定殖在腸黏膜特定棲所。因此，IgA除了具有清除病原體的作用之外，也可強化宿主-微生菌共生的作用。依據上文內容和習得的知識，回答第36-38題：

36. IgA是由下列哪種細胞產生？

(A) T細胞

(B) B細胞

(C) 肥大細胞

(D) 巨噬細胞

脆弱擬桿菌（Bacteroides fragilis）是人類腸道優勢菌，科學家發現此菌有一基因座（genetic locus），稱之為共生定殖因子（commensal colonization factors；ccfABCDE），形成下述的CCF系統，此系統除了可誘發人體產生能與共生菌結合的特異性IgA，亦可調節菌體表面構型，使IgA經由特異性免疫辨識與之結合，進而促進細菌黏附和定殖在腸黏膜上。科學家研究菌體表面構型改變的分子機制時，發現CCF系統所調控的基因，是與脆弱擬桿菌莢膜聚醣（polysaccharide;PS）的合成與利用的基因座群（loci）有關。若ccfABCDE基因座有缺失（△ccf；△指基因表現缺失）時，則突變菌株菌體的莢膜層厚度較野生型菌株（WT）薄外，也發現此突變株莢膜的聚醣C（PSC）下降，而聚醣A（PSA）增加。若將PSC合成缺失（△PSC）的脆弱擬桿菌突變株殖入小鼠，發現此突變株在直腸黏膜定殖菌落量比野生型菌株有顯著下降的趨勢；反之若將△PSA殖入小鼠，則其定殖菌落量和野生型菌株相近。以上研究顯示脆弱擬桿菌和其他共生菌株同樣需要IgA的反應，排斥外來的競爭者並使共生菌穩定定殖在腸黏膜特定棲所。因此，IgA除了具有清除病原體的作用之外，也可強化宿主-微生菌共生的作用。依據上文內容和習得的知識，回答第36-38題：

Reading 2: Questions 39–41 form a group.

COVID-19 vaccines are mainly of four types: attenuated vaccines, DNA vaccines, mRNA vaccines and protein vaccines. Among the vaccines currently administered in various countries, apart from attenuated vaccines, the other three are designed against the spike protein of the COVID-19 WU virus strain first discovered in China, which mainly includes the amino acid sequence of the receptor binding domain (RBD) (black box region in Figure 8). A DNA vaccine uses an adenovirus as a vector for the COVID-19 virus gene; after it enters human cells, the spike protein is produced through transcription and translation. An mRNA vaccine introduces an artificially synthesised mRNA, which, once it enters cells, can be translated into the spike protein of this virus. A protein vaccine injects the spike protein directly into the human body. The ultimate aim of all these vaccines is to use the spike protein to induce the human body to produce enough neutralising antibodies against the virus.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/biology-olympiads-bank/main/images/twbio-2021-1-fig8.png

After the WU strain, the British mutant strain (UK strain) was discovered. The spike protein of the UK strain has the D614G mutation (Figure 8). D614G means that the amino acid at position 614 of the spike protein has mutated from aspartic acid (D) to glycine (G), which strengthens the binding of the spike protein of the UK mutant to the human cell receptor (ACE2) and raises the infection efficiency. A few months later, the South African mutant strain (SA strain) was found in South Africa; the spike protein of this SA mutant has the D614G mutation like the UK strain, but the RBD region of the SA strain has in addition the E484K mutation (Figure 8), that is, the amino acid at position 484 of the spike protein has mutated from glutamic acid (E) to lysine (K).

In addition, the spike proteins on COVID-19 virus particles aggregate as trimers to form one unit, and the three spike proteins of this unit are usually in the closed form. If one of the spike proteins of the trimer unit is in the open form, that open spike protein can bind to the human ACE2 receptor, causing the viral envelope to fuse with the host cell membrane and leading to infection. Studies have found that the D614G mutation increases the proportion of spike proteins in the open form, making them bind more easily to the human receptor. Based on the passage above and the knowledge you have learnt, answer Questions 39–41:

39. Which of the following statements about COVID-19 vaccines is correct?

(A) COVID-19 attenuated vaccines are prepared from the spike protein of the virus

(B) The COVID-19 DNA vaccines or mRNA vaccines currently used internationally cause cells to produce the viral spike protein after entering the human body in order to induce passive immunity

(C) A vaccine can fight the virus only if it can induce the human body to produce a sufficient amount of neutralising antibodies

(D) The spike proteins produced in the human body by the COVID-19 vaccines currently given to people do not include the receptor binding domain of the virus

閱讀二

新冠肺炎（COVID-19）疫苗主要有四類型：減毒疫苗、DNA疫苗、mRNA疫苗及蛋白質疫苗。目前各國施打的疫苗中，除了減毒疫苗外，其它三種則是針對最先在中國發現的COVID-19 WU病毒株的棘蛋白（spike）而設計，其中主要包括受體結合區（receptor binding domain；RBD）胺基酸序列（圖8黑框區）。DNA疫苗是將COVID-19病毒基因以腺病毒為載體，當它進入人體細胞後，經轉錄及轉譯產生棘蛋白；mRNA疫苗則是導入人工合成的一段mRNA，當它進入細胞中，即可以被轉譯出此病毒的棘蛋白。蛋白質疫苗則是直接將棘蛋白打入人體。這些疫苗最終目的都是用棘蛋白誘發人體產生足夠的中和性抗體以對抗病毒。

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/biology-olympiads-bank/main/images/twbio-2021-1-fig8.png

繼WU病毒株後，又發現英國突變株（UK株）。UK株的棘蛋白產生了D614G突變點（圖8）。D614G的意思是棘蛋白上的第614位置的胺基酸由天門冬胺酸（D）突變成甘胺酸（G），導致UK突變株的棘蛋白與人類細胞受體（ACE2）結合能力增強，提升感染效率。幾個月後，南非發現了南非突變株（SA株），該SA突變株的棘蛋白與UK株一樣具有D614G突變，然而SA株的RBD區域多產生了E484K突變（圖8），也就是棘蛋白的第484位置的胺基酸由肤胺酸（E）突變成離胺酸（K）。

此外，COVID-19病毒顆粒上棘蛋白是以三元體狀態聚合成一個單元，該單元的三個棘蛋白通常是封閉狀態（close form）存在。若三元體單元其中一個棘蛋白呈現開放狀態（open form），則該開放狀態的棘蛋白可以與人類ACE2受體結合，造成病毒套膜與寄主細胞膜進行融合，導致感染。研究發現D614G突變使棘蛋白開放態比例增加，使其更易與人類受體結合。依據上文內容和習得的知識，回答第39-41題：

39. 下列有關COVID-19疫苗之敘述，何者正確？

(A) COVID-19減毒疫苗以病毒的棘蛋白製備而成

(B) 目前國際上使用的COVID-19DNA疫苗或mRNA疫苗，是在進入人體後使細胞產生病毒棘蛋白以誘發被動免疫

(C) 疫苗要能誘發人體產生足夠量的中和性抗體才能對抗病毒

(D) 目前人們接種的COVID-19疫苗在人體產生的棘蛋白皆不包括病毒的受體結合區

Reading 3: Questions 42–43 form a group.

Epiphytic orchids such as the moth orchid (Phalaenopsis) are common ornamental flowers. The pollen of such flowers is not scattered as individual grains but is stuck together into pollinia, in order to attract insects to pollinate them. Orchid seeds have no endosperm and cannot germinate on their own nutrients like the seeds of other seed plants. To understand the puzzle of flower-form evolution in the orchid family, Taiwanese scientists cooperated with an international team to study the differences in gene expression between epiphytic orchids and the more primitive terrestrial orchid-like plants (pseudo-orchids). Morphologically, epiphytic orchids can climb and grow on tree trunks and have a labellum, whereas terrestrial pseudo-orchids cannot climb tree trunks and have no labellum, but their petals show symmetry (Figure 9); their pollen retains the primitive scattered form. From studies of gene expression levels, the following two conclusions were found: (1) the expression levels of the B gene and the E gene in flowers with a labellum are higher; (2) epiphytic ability is related to high expression of the A gene. In addition, the scientists also compared the genomes of orchids and seed plants and obtained two further inferences: (1) loss of the P gene is related to the evolution of pollinia in orchids; (2) loss of the M gene affects the formation of seeds with endosperm. Based on the passage above and the knowledge you have learnt, answer Questions 42–43:

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/biology-olympiads-bank/main/images/twbio-2021-1-fig9.png

Figure labels (Chinese → English): 花瓣 → petal; 唇瓣 → labellum; 對稱花瓣 → symmetric petals; 附生性蘭花 → epiphytic orchid; 地生性擬蘭花 → terrestrial pseudo-orchid

42. Which of the following is correct about the characteristics of pseudo-orchids?

(A) They can be found on tree trunks in their native habitat

(B) The petals are asymmetric

(C) Their A gene has a high expression level

(D) The expression levels of the B gene and the E gene are lower than in epiphytic orchids

Epiphytic orchids such as the moth orchid (Phalaenopsis) are common ornamental flowers. The pollen of such flowers is not scattered as individual grains but is stuck together into pollinia, in order to attract insects to pollinate them. Real-time PCR (real-time polymerase chain reaction) is a technique in which, during the DNA amplification reaction, a fluorescent dye binds to the amplified DNA, and the whole PCR process is combined with real-time fluorescence detection to determine how much of the target DNA fragment is present. To interpret real-time PCR data, a fluorescence threshold must first be set; exceeding this threshold means that a signal has appeared, and the number of PCR cycles at which the threshold is exceeded is called the Ct (cycle threshold; Ct) value. Questions 10–11 form a group.

At high altitudes in Taiwan there are five endemic species of salamanders whose habitats hardly overlap. Researchers used DNA sequences to construct the phylogenetic relationships of the different salamander species (Figure 2) and inferred that the ancestors of Taiwan's salamanders originated in southern Japan and dispersed to Taiwan across a land bridge during the glacial period. In the subsequent "interglacial period", the salamanders within the island of Taiwan began to diverge and evolve into five different species; this hypothesis is called the within-island divergence hypothesis. However, there is still no decisive evidence to prove whether the ancestors of the salamanders within the island of Taiwan differentiated into different species only after arriving in Taiwan, or had already speciated elsewhere long before and then each colonised Taiwan separately; the latter is called the outside-island divergence hypothesis.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/biology-olympiads-bank/main/images/twbio-2022-1-fig2.png

Figure labels (Chinese → English): 臺灣的山椒魚 → salamanders of Taiwan; 阿里山山椒魚 → Alishan salamander (Hynobius arisanensis); 楚南氏山椒魚 → Chunan's salamander (Hynobius sonani); 南湖山椒魚 → Nanhu salamander (Hynobius glacialis); 臺灣山椒魚 → Taiwan salamander (Hynobius formosanus); 觀霧山椒魚 → Guanwu salamander (Hynobius fuca); 日本南部的山椒魚 → salamander of southern Japan; 中國大陸的山椒魚 → salamander of mainland China

10. Regarding the speciation of Taiwan's salamander species, which of the following observations better supports the within-island divergence hypothesis?

(A) Salamanders have poor dispersal ability and a small range of activity and cannot cross mountains

(B) Salamanders of different species have different preferences for the body colour of the opposite sex when choosing mates

(C) Salamanders differ between species in their preferences for egg-laying sites

(D) Embryos obtained by artificial insemination hybridising different salamander species cannot develop normally

臺灣高海拔有五種棲息地幾乎不重疊的特有種山椒魚。學者以DNA序列建構不同山椒魚物種的親緣關係（圖2），推測臺灣的山椒魚祖先應源自日本南部，經冰河時期的陸橋播遷至臺灣。在之後的「間冰期」，臺灣本島內的山椒魚開始分歧演化成五種不同物種，這個假說稱為島內分化論。但至今仍沒有決定性證據，可證明臺灣本島內山椒魚的祖先是來到臺灣後才分化成不同物種，或是早在其他地方種化之後才各自拓遷來臺，稱為島外分化論。

Reading 1: Questions 20–22 form a group.

When an RNA virus replicates, it uses its own RNA (called the positive-strand RNA) as a template and uses a replicase to produce negative-strand RNA. The newly generated negative-strand RNA then serves as a template, and the same replicase is used to produce many positive-strand RNAs. These positive-strand RNAs are translated into the proteins needed by the virus, such as the coat protein, and after the positive-strand RNA has been wrapped to form virus particles, it can infect the next cell. However, in order to fight infection by plant viruses, plant cells have evolved an RNA hydrolase, DCL4, which specifically cuts and hydrolyses viral RNA that is undergoing replication (a double-stranded RNA structure). Conversely, in order to resist the attack of DCL4, plant viruses have also specialised a suppressor protein, SUP, which inhibits the defence response of DCL4 so that the virus can infect smoothly (Figure 5).

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/biology-olympiads-bank/main/images/twbio-2022-1-fig5.png

Figure labels (Chinese → English): 植物病毒 → plant virus; 切碎病毒 RNA → shreds viral RNA; WT 植物 → WT plant; 促進 → promotes; 抑制 → inhibits

Plants infected by viruses show symptoms such as abnormal leaf development and dwarfing of the plant. Using gene mutation technology, scientists knocked out the DCL4 gene of normal wild-type tobacco WT to produce a mutant line, dcl4. They also produced a virus strain, sup, in which the SUP gene is mutated. The scientists designed two sets of experiments in which these plant materials were infected with the viruses: Experiment 1 tested the effect of the wild-type virus on the plant height and leaf area of tobacco, and Experiment 2 tested the effect of the virus before and after mutation on the plant height and leaf area of tobacco. The experimental results are shown in Figure 6. Answer Questions 20–22 based on this passage and the knowledge you have learned.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/biology-olympiads-bank/main/images/twbio-2022-1-fig6.png

[Multiple choice — one or more correct options]

Reading 2: Questions 23–25 form a group.

Interferon (IFN) is produced because of virus infection of cells and is an important antiviral molecule in animals, but its detailed regulatory mechanism has not yet been fully elucidated. In 2022, scientists found that the heat shock binding protein HBP21 can induce the expression of interferon by affecting the action of interferon regulatory factor 3 (IRF3). IRF3 is a transcription factor that can regulate the expression of IFN; unactivated IRF3 is located in the cytoplasm. After virus infection, IRF3 is phosphorylated into the activated IRF3-℗, which then moves into the nucleus and, together with other transcription factors, promotes the expression of IFN mRNA. Scientists demonstrated experimentally that strong expression of HBP21 can promote the phosphorylation and activation of IRF3, and the expression of IFN was observed. It was later also confirmed that virus infection also causes phosphorylation of HBP21, and that HBP21-℗ also plays a key role in the activation of IRF3. This study shows that many unknown regulatory factors are still involved in the antiviral regulatory mechanism; if they can be gradually clarified, this should help the development of antiviral strategies. Answer Questions 23–25 based on this passage and the knowledge you have learned.

23. Based on the experimental results of the molecular regulatory mechanism described in the passage, which of the following phenomena can be demonstrated?

(A) Interferon can cause cells to produce phosphorylated antibodies that take part in the antiviral mechanism

(B) HBP21 is also an effector molecule that triggers the antiviral mechanism

(C) HBP21 can cause inactivation of IRF3 to trigger the antiviral mechanism

(D) HBP21 can cause phosphorylation of the IFN protein and thereby stimulate the antiviral mechanism

(E) Virus-infected cells express large amounts of IFN mRNA

Interferon (IFN) is produced because of virus infection of cells and is an important antiviral molecule in animals, but its detailed regulatory mechanism has not yet been fully elucidated. Reading 3: Questions 26–28 form a group.

Since Ivan Pavlov discovered classical conditioning (conditioned reflex), scientists have used this behaviour as one of the experimental models for studying the mechanisms of learning and memory formation. Classical conditioning includes several elements: the conditioned stimulus, the unconditioned stimulus, the unconditioned response, and the training process. Classical conditioning means that after training, an animal learns to associate the two events, the unconditioned stimulus and the conditioned stimulus, and produces the reflex action of the unconditioned response. For example, before feeding a dog, Pavlov would first ring a bell; after the stimulus pattern of bell ringing and feeding had been repeated several times, the sound of the bell (conditioned stimulus), which under normal circumstances could not trigger salivation in the dog, made the dog begin to secrete saliva (unconditioned response) because it anticipated that feeding (unconditioned stimulus) would occur.

The Nobel laureate Eric Kandel carried out a series of studies using an invertebrate, the sea hare (Aplysia), as the animal model, in order to reveal the neuronal mechanisms of this kind of learning behaviour. Compared with mammals, the advantages of using an invertebrate as a model are: (1) the nervous system is small and simple, and the functional role of every neuron in the system is clear, so the neurons and related circuits participating in a particular behaviour can be clearly identified; (2) when carrying out experiments with intracellular electrophysiological recording from individual neurons, the giant neurons of invertebrates are easier to use than mammalian neurons; (3) invertebrates have short life histories and small genomes, which favours genetic and molecular biological studies. Kandel's results confirmed that, in the neural circuit of Aplysia, changes in the efficacy of synaptic transmission between sensory neurons and motor neurons are the physiological basis for producing these learning behaviours.

Recently, using electrophysiology and transgenic technology, it has also been confirmed that in the mammalian brain, plastic changes in the efficacy of synaptic transmission between neurons are likewise the basic mechanism for the generation of learning and memory and for other functions. Answer Questions 26–28 based on this passage and the knowledge you have learned.

(B) Under normal circumstances, the conditioned stimulus can trigger the unconditioned response in the animal without training

(D) The conditioned stimulus and the unconditioned stimulus must be of the same kind, both being visual or both being auditory stimuli

閱讀三

自帕夫洛夫（Ivan Pavlov）發現古典制約反射（條件反射）以來，科學家一直以此行為來研究學習記憶產生過程機制的實驗模式之一。古典制約反射包含幾項要素：制約刺激、非制約刺激、非制約反應與訓練過程。而古典制約反射是指在經過訓練後，動物會學習將非制約刺激與制約刺激兩個事件聯結在一起，產生非制約反應的反射動作。例如，帕夫洛夫每次餵狗前會先搖鈴，重複數次搖鈴、餵食的刺激模式後，原本正常情形下無法引發狗唾液分泌反應的鈴聲（制約刺激），使狗因預期會發生餵食（非制約刺激），而開始分泌唾液（非制約反應）。

諾貝爾獎得主坎德爾（Eric Kandel）利用一種無脊椎動物-海兔為動物模式進行一連串的研究，以揭示這類學習行為的神經細胞學機制。相較於哺乳動物，使用無脊椎動物為模式的好處為（1）神經系統小而簡單，系統中每一個神經細胞的功能角色都很清楚，因此可以清楚鑑定出參與特定行為的神經細胞與相關迴路；（2）進行個別神經細胞作胞內電生理記錄的實驗時，無脊椎動物的超大型神經細胞，比用哺乳動物神經細胞容易；（3）無脊椎動物生活史短，基因體也小，有利於遺傳學與分子生物學的研究。坎德爾的研究結果證實，在海兔的神經迴路中，感覺神經細胞與運動神經細胞間的突觸傳導效能的改變，是產生這些學習行為的生理基礎。

最近利用電生理學與基因轉殖技術，也證實在哺乳動物的大腦中，神經細胞與神經細胞間突觸傳導效能的可塑性改變，也是學習記憶產生與其他功能表現的基本機轉。依本文及所習得的知識回答第26-28題。

(A) 非制約刺激能引發非制約反應，且不用經過訓練

(B) 正常情形下，制約刺激可引發動物非制約反應，且不用經過訓練

(C) 訓練的過程中，必須隨機的重複給予動物多次的制約或非制約刺激

(D) 制約刺激與非制約刺激必須具有同質性，都是屬視覺或屬聽覺刺激

The kidney is the excretory organ of the human body. Blood in the renal artery enters the capillaries of the glomerulus through the afferent arteriole, and small molecules in the blood can enter Bowman's capsule of the renal tubule here by filtration to form the filtrate. Useful substances in the filtrate are reabsorbed back into the body and enter the capillaries surrounding the renal tubule, while excessive or harmful substances in the blood are secreted by the renal tubule into the filtrate, and finally urine is formed and excreted from the body (Figure 10).

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/biology-olympiads-bank/main/images/twbio-2022-1-fig10.png

Figure labels (Chinese → English): 絲球體微血管 → glomerular capillaries; 鮑氏囊 → Bowman's capsule; 管周微血管 → peritubular capillaries; 物質甲 → substance 甲; 物質乙 → substance 乙; 物質丙 → substance 丙; 物質丁 → substance 丁; 尿液 → urine

Table 1

$$\begin{array}{|l|c|c|}\hline \text{Substance} & \text{Amount filtered per day} & \text{Amount excreted per day} \\ \hline \text{Glucose} & \text{180 mg} & 0 \\ \hline \text{Sodium ions} & \text{630 g} & \text{3.2 g} \\ \hline \text{Urea} & \text{50 g} & \text{28 g} \\ \hline \text{Water} & \text{180 L} & \text{1.8 L} \\ \hline \end{array}$$

34. According to Figure 10, which of the following statements about substances 甲 to 丁 is correct?

(A) A small amount of substance 甲 is filtered and the rest is secreted into the urine

(B) Substance 乙 is completely reabsorbed after being filtered

(C) Substance 丙 is filtered and partly reabsorbed

(D) Substance 丁 is filtered but not secreted

The golden orb-weaving spider with a "human face" pattern (the "human-face spider") is a common predator; the female stays in the middle of its web, waiting for insects to fly into the net on their own. Besides the "human face" on the dorsal side, which is an eye-catching focus, the markings on their abdomen are also very conspicuous. Apart from a red dot at the tip, all the markings on the ventral side are bright yellow. It is known that insect vision is not sensitive to red, and yellow is the part of the spectrum that is more eye-catching to insects. The researchers therefore made paper spiders of five different ventral colours or marking patterns (Figure 11), then found woven webs in a forest, replaced the human-face spider sitting in the web with a paper spider, recorded video for fixed periods of time, and analysed the images to count the number of insects caught in the web (Figure 12). Questions 45–47 form a group.

The pancreas has two kinds of endocrine cells, α and β cells, of which α cells secrete glucagon and β cells secrete insulin. The secretion of insulin is directly regulated by the blood glucose concentration. Scientists have found that β cells can sense glucose in the surrounding environment. When the glucose concentration exceeds a threshold, β cells begin secretory activity; conversely, when the glucose concentration is below the threshold, β cells stop secreting. When β cells secrete insulin, they also simultaneously secrete another hormone called amylin, which inhibits the secretion of glucagon; however, after injection of an antibody that can bind amylin, the binding of amylin to its receptor is completely blocked, and in the absence of amylin action, α cells continue to secrete glucagon. Answer Questions 45–47 based on what you have learned and the information provided above.

Reading 1: Questions 20–22 form a group.

Vitamins are among the indispensable factors for the various physiological reactions of organisms and, according to their structural characteristics, can be roughly divided into water-soluble vitamins and fat-soluble vitamins. The B vitamins are a class of water-soluble vitamins; they dissolve readily in water, and excess intake is excreted in the urine and does not accumulate excessively in the body. Among the B vitamins, vitamin B12 has a relatively complex ring structure with a cobalt ion bound at the centre of the ring, and is therefore also called cobalamin. The human body cannot synthesise vitamin B12 by itself and must obtain it from food, for example eggs, milk, fish and meat. Vitamin B12 in food can bind to the R protein (haptocorrin) in the stomach to form a B12-haptocorrin complex, which passes from the stomach through the pylorus into the intestine. In the intestine, this complex is digested by proteases, releasing vitamin B12, which then binds to intrinsic factor (IF) secreted by the parietal cells of the stomach to form an IF-B12 complex. This IF-B12 complex can then be recognised by receptors on the mucosal epithelial cells of the ileum and enter the cells by endocytosis. The intestinal epithelial cells then release vitamin B12 into the circulatory system, where vitamin B12 in the plasma binds to transcobalamin II (TC-II) and is transported in the body. After being transported to the liver through the hepatic portal vein, vitamin B12 is stored mainly in forms such as methylcobalamin and adenosylcobalamin, while part of it is sent through the circulatory system to the tissues of the whole body to perform its functions. Vitamin B12 can be metabolised in the liver and discharged into the intestine with the bile, so that part of the vitamin B12 can be absorbed again. Answer Questions 20–22 based on this text and the knowledge you have learned.

20. In which form is vitamin B12 mainly absorbed by the human intestine?

(A) Vitamin B12 monomer

(B) B12-haptocorrin complex

(C) B12-TC-II complex

(D) IF-B12 complex
