Reading 1: Questions 20–22 form a group.

Vitamins are among the indispensable factors for the various physiological reactions of organisms and, according to their structural characteristics, can be roughly divided into water-soluble vitamins and fat-soluble vitamins. The B vitamins are a class of water-soluble vitamins; they dissolve readily in water, and excess intake is excreted in the urine and does not accumulate excessively in the body. Among the B vitamins, vitamin B12 has a relatively complex ring structure with a cobalt ion bound at the centre of the ring, and is therefore also called cobalamin. The human body cannot synthesise vitamin B12 by itself and must obtain it from food, for example eggs, milk, fish and meat. Vitamin B12 in food can bind to the R protein (haptocorrin) in the stomach to form a B12-haptocorrin complex, which passes from the stomach through the pylorus into the intestine. In the intestine, this complex is digested by proteases, releasing vitamin B12, which then binds to intrinsic factor (IF) secreted by the parietal cells of the stomach to form an IF-B12 complex. This IF-B12 complex can then be recognised by receptors on the mucosal epithelial cells of the ileum and enter the cells by endocytosis. The intestinal epithelial cells then release vitamin B12 into the circulatory system, where vitamin B12 in the plasma binds to transcobalamin II (TC-II) and is transported in the body. After being transported to the liver through the hepatic portal vein, vitamin B12 is stored mainly in forms such as methylcobalamin and adenosylcobalamin, while part of it is sent through the circulatory system to the tissues of the whole body to perform its functions. Vitamin B12 can be metabolised in the liver and discharged into the intestine with the bile, so that part of the vitamin B12 can be absorbed again. [Multiple choice — one or more correct options]

Reading 2: Questions 23–25 form a group.

Ants are very typical social insects, and there are complex and close relationships among their developmental stages from egg, larva and pupa to adult. For example, the adults of the parthenogenetic clonal raider ant (Ooceraea biroi), besides caring for eggs and pupae, also carry larvae, whose mobility is limited, to places with suitable food. Scientists were curious how the clonal raider ant maintains such close interactions. Studies show that the pupae of the clonal raider ant excrete a social fluid, and this secretion elicits caring behaviour of the adults toward the pupae and larvae. During the experiments, the scientists found that if the social fluid is not removed, the pupae are infected by mould and die; if the larvae do not eat the social fluid, their growth is retarded and their survival rate decreases; and adults also tend to move larvae to the vicinity of pupae that have the secretion. Composition analysis showed that the social fluid is similar to the moulting fluid produced during insect moulting and contains many substances related to protein degradation and chitin breakdown. Besides showing the role played by pupae in the ant colony, this study also elucidates the mechanism behind the caring behaviour of the colony. Answer Questions 23–25 based on this text and the knowledge you have learned.

23. According to the observations described in the article, which of the following statements are correct?

(A) Ants of every stage secrete the same social fluid

(B) The social fluid of the pupae affects the growth of the larvae

(C) The caring behaviour of adults occurs mainly during the moulting stage of the larvae

(D) Only parthenogenetic ants can secrete the social fluid

(E) The caring behaviour of adults is involved in the interaction between pupae and larvae

閱讀二

螞蟻是非常典型的社會性昆蟲，他們從卵、幼蟲、蛹到成蟲等各發育期相互間都有複雜且緊密關係。舉例而言，孤雌生殖的畢氏粗角蟻（Ooceraea biroi）的成蟻，除了照顧卵和蛹外，同時也會搬運移動能力有限的幼蟲至有適當食物之處。科學家好奇畢氏粗角蟻是如何維持這種密切的互動關係。研究顯示，畢氏粗角蟻的蛹會排出一種社會性分泌物（social fluid），此分泌物會引起成蟻對蛹與幼蟲的照顧行為。在實驗過程中，科學家發現社會性分泌物若未被清除，蛹就會被黴菌感染而致死；若幼蟲沒有吃到社會性分泌物，則會有生長遲緩與存活率下降的現象；成蟻也傾向將幼蟲搬到有分泌物的蛹附近。成分鑑定結果顯示，社會性分泌物與昆蟲蛻皮過程所產生的蛻皮液相似，含有許多蛋白質降解與幾丁質分解相關物質。此研究顯示蛹在螞蟻群體中所扮演的角色外，也解析蟻群照顧行為的運作機轉。依據本文及已習得知識回答23-25題。

(B) 蛹的社會性分泌物會影響幼蟲生長狀況

(C) 成蟻照顧行為主要是發生在幼蟲蛻皮階段

(D) 只有孤雌生殖的螞蟻可分泌社會性分泌物

(E) 成蟻的照顧行為參與了蛹與幼蟲的互動

The main symptom of anaphylaxis in humans is a sharp drop in blood pressure, whereas in the experimental mouse model (normal body temperature 37±1°C) the core body temperature drops by about 6°C within 30 minutes of the onset of the allergy; these can have fatal consequences. An allergen causes B cells to produce IgE, and IgE forms a complex with mast cells (MCs) (IgE / MCs). When the allergen enters the body again, the mast cells bound to IgE are activated and release inflammatory factors (including histamine, tumour necrosis factor, platelet-activating factor, proteases, etc.). The core body temperature balance of animals is regulated by a thermoregulatory neural circuit: (1) sensory neurons sensitive to peripheral temperature, located in the dorsal root ganglia, trigeminal ganglia, nodose ganglia and so on → (2) spinal cord → (3) the LPB nucleus region of the brainstem → (4) the thermoregulatory centre in the preoptic area (POA) of the hypothalamus. The latest research reports that the marked drop in core body temperature in IgE-induced anaphylaxis in mice is related to the substances secreted by mast cells activating the above thermoregulatory neural circuit, which in turn affects heat production by brown adipose tissue (BAT). Answer Questions 26–28 based on this text and the knowledge you have learned.

During the breeding season, males fly low within their territories and display their tail feathers to attract several females to come, pair and build nests. Reading passage 1

All non-ape primates have tails, whereas apes have all lost their tails (Figure 7; Ma stands for million years). Scientists recently found that the $TBXT$ gene is associated with the loss of the tail in apes. In primates, an $AluSx1$ element sequence is present in the fifth intron, between exon 5 (E5) and exon 6 (E6) of the $TBXT$ gene (Figure 8a). The $TBXT$ RNA of non-apes undergoes normal RNA splicing, joining all the exons into a mature mRNA, which is translated into the full-length TBXT protein (Figure 8a).

Although the $TBXT$ RNA of apes also undergoes normal RNA splicing to produce a mature $TBXT$ mRNA and is translated into the full-length TBXT protein (Figure 8b), studies show that the sixth intron of the ape $TBXT$ gene carries an additional $AluY$ element sequence (Figure 8b). Because the $AluSx1$ and $AluY$ element sequences are exactly reversed relative to each other, the $AluSx1$ and $AluY$ sequences on the ape $TBXT$ RNA can pair with each other to form a special hairpin-like structure that encloses the E6 region (Figure 8b). This causes alternative splicing (AS; Figure 8b) of the $TBXT$ RNA, so that E6 is spliced out, producing a shorter $TBXT$ mRNA that is translated into the truncated TBXT protein (Figure 8b). In other words, both the full-length and the truncated forms of TBXT protein exist in ape cells (Figure 8b), and it is speculated that the truncated protein can induce the loss of the tail in apes.

The researchers then used tailed laboratory mice for gene transfer and constructed heterozygous gene-mutant mice in which one $TBXT$ gene lacks the E6 exon, that is, mice that express both the full-length and the truncated protein. The results proved that the truncated TBXT protein is indeed sufficient to induce loss of the tail. It is worth mentioning that the full-length TBXT protein is crucial for embryonic development, and mice lacking the full-length TBXT protein die. Based on the passage and the relevant knowledge you have learned, answer Questions 20–22.

閱讀一

靈長類的非類人猿都有尾巴，而類人猿尾巴卻都已消失（圖7，Ma代表百萬年）。最近科學家發現$TBXT$基因和類人猿尾巴喪失有關。靈長類$TBXT$基因的外顯子5（E5）及外顯子6（E6）間的第5內含子序列中都存在一個$AluSx1$元素序列（圖8a）。非類人猿的$TBXT$ RNA會進行正常的RNA剪接，將所有的外顯子連接成為成熟mRNA，並且轉譯成為TBXT全長型蛋白質（圖8a）。

類人猿的$TBXT$ RNA雖也會進行正常的RNA剪接產生成熟型$TBXT$ mRNA並轉譯出TBXT全長型蛋白質（圖8b），然而研究顯示類人猿的$TBXT$基因的第6內含子序列上則多出一段$AluY$元素序列（圖8b）。由於$AluSx1$與$AluY$兩個元素序列剛好相反，因此類人猿$TBXT$ RNA上的$AluSx1$與$AluY$的序列剛好可以配對形成一個髮夾狀特殊結構，並將E6區域包含在此結構上（圖8b），結果導致$TBXT$ RNA產生選擇性剪接（alternative splicing: AS；圖8b），使E6被剪掉，產生一個較短的$TBXT$ mRNA，並轉譯出TBXT截短型蛋白質（圖8b）。換句話說，類人猿的細胞中，同時存在有TBXT的全長型及截短型蛋白質（圖8b），並推測截短型蛋白質可誘導類人猿尾巴丟失。

研究人員接著選擇有尾巴的小白鼠進行基因轉殖，建構基因突變雜合子小鼠，使該鼠有一個$TBXT$基因是不含E6外顯子，亦即此小鼠同時可表達全長型和截短型蛋白質，結果證明TBXT截短型蛋白質確實足以誘發尾部丟失。值得一提的是全長型TBXT蛋白質對胚胎發育至關重要，小鼠缺乏全長型TBXT蛋白質則會死亡。依本文內容及已習得相關知識回答20-22題。

研究人員接著選擇有尾巴的小白鼠進行基因轉殖，建構基因突變雜合子小鼠，使該鼠有一個$TBXT$基因是不含E6外顯子，亦即此小鼠同時可表達全長型和截短型蛋白質，結果證明TBXT截短型蛋白質確實足以誘發尾部丟失。值得一提的是全長型TBXT蛋白質對胚胎發育至關重要，小鼠缺乏全長型TBXT蛋白質則會死亡。依本文內容及已習得相關知識回答20-22題。

(A) 在$TBXT$基因E5與E6之間的內含子序列，經選擇性剪接不一定會被切除

(B) 選擇性剪接使全長和截短型$TBXT$ mRNA不能同時出現在同一細胞

(C) 全長和截短型$TBXT$ mRNA只差在有無E6序列

Reading passage 1

All non-ape primates have tails, whereas apes have all lost their tails (Figure 7; Ma stands for million years). Scientists recently found that the $TBXT$ gene is associated with the loss of the tail in apes. In primates, an $AluSx1$ element sequence is present in the fifth intron, between exon 5 (E5) and exon 6 (E6) of the $TBXT$ gene (Figure 8a). The $TBXT$ RNA of non-apes undergoes normal RNA splicing, joining all the exons into a mature mRNA, which is translated into the full-length TBXT protein (Figure 8a).

Although the $TBXT$ RNA of apes also undergoes normal RNA splicing to produce a mature $TBXT$ mRNA and is translated into the full-length TBXT protein (Figure 8b), studies show that the sixth intron of the ape $TBXT$ gene carries an additional $AluY$ element sequence (Figure 8b). Because the $AluSx1$ and $AluY$ element sequences are exactly reversed relative to each other, the $AluSx1$ and $AluY$ sequences on the ape $TBXT$ RNA can pair with each other to form a special hairpin-like structure that encloses the E6 region (Figure 8b). This causes alternative splicing (AS; Figure 8b) of the $TBXT$ RNA, so that E6 is spliced out, producing a shorter $TBXT$ mRNA that is translated into the truncated TBXT protein (Figure 8b). In other words, both the full-length and the truncated forms of TBXT protein exist in ape cells (Figure 8b), and it is speculated that the truncated protein can induce the loss of the tail in apes.

The researchers then used tailed laboratory mice for gene transfer and constructed heterozygous gene-mutant mice in which one $TBXT$ gene lacks the E6 exon, that is, mice that express both the full-length and the truncated protein. The results proved that the truncated TBXT protein is indeed sufficient to induce loss of the tail. It is worth mentioning that the full-length TBXT protein is crucial for embryonic development, and mice lacking the full-length TBXT protein die. [Single choice]

Reading passage 2

Variation in external form such as body size and skin colour is often influenced by the level of gene expression. Take different breeds of dogs as an example: their body shape, size and even coat colour are extremely different. For instance, the body weights of the small Chihuahua and the large Dalmatian can differ by as much as ten times, and this difference in form is the result of breeding over the past hundred years. To understand how individual differences between breeds arise at the genetic level, scientists carried out whole-genome sequence analysis. Comparing the DNA sequences of 4 small breeds and 4 large breeds of pure lines, they found two loci on chromosome 15 related to the determination of body size, and further analysed single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs).

An SNP refers to polymorphism in the nucleotide at the same position of the same DNA segment among different individuals in a population, which can lead to diversity in gene sequences. Polymorphism is a common phenomenon in nature and is related to the diversity of phenotypes in organisms, so it can be used as a molecular marker to study the correlation between each SNP and a trait. The researchers also found that the serum concentration of IGF1 protein in small breeds is clearly lower than that of IGF1 in large breeds, and the amount of IGF1 mRNA in small breeds is only about 30% of that in large breeds. This study shows that the expression level of IGF1 plays a very important role in determining individual size. Based on this passage and the relevant knowledge, answer Questions 23–25.

23. Based on the above analysis, which of the following inferences is correct?

(A) Variation in DNA sequence causes different levels of gene expression and thus individual differences

(B) The expression level of IGF1 affects the distribution of SNPs

(C) SNPs cannot be used to look for genes that may cause disease

(D) Only one gene on chromosome 15 affects the determination of individual size

[單選題]

閱讀二

個體的大小、膚色等外部形態之變異，常受基因表現程度的影響。以不同品系的狗為例，其身型、大小甚至毛色皆極為不同，以小型犬吉娃娃與大型犬大麥町為例，其體重差距可高達十倍之多，而此形態之不同是近百年來育種的結果。科學家為了解在基因層面如何造成品系之間的個體差異，進行全基因體的序列分析。以純品系的4種小型犬及4種大型犬的DNA序列做比較，發現在染色體15上有2個基因座與個體大小決定相關，並進一步分析單核苷酸多型性（single nucleotide polymorphism；SNP）。

SNP是指族群中不同個體同一DNA片段同位點核苷酸的多型性，可導致基因序列的多樣性。多型性是自然界中常見現象，與生物表現型的多樣性相關，因此可做為分子標記來研究各SNP與性狀的相關性。研究人員又發現小型犬血清中之IGF1蛋白質濃度明顯低於大型犬IGF1的濃度；小型犬的IGF1 mRNA量只有大型犬的30%左右。這項研究顯示，IGF1的表現量對個體大小的決定扮演很重要的角色。請依本文所述及相關知識，回答23-25題。

23. 基於上述分析，下列推論何者正確？

(A) DNA序列變異造成基因表現量不同而造成個體差異

(B) IGF1的表現量影響SNP的分布

(C) SNP無法應用在尋找可能導致疾病的基因

(D) 染色體15上只有一個基因影響個體大小之決定

Reading passage 3

The walls of plant spores and pollen (sporopollenin walls) contain a special, highly resistant protein that does not decompose easily. After being dispersed in large quantities, they gradually fall to the ground or sink into the mud at the bottom of water by gravity and are preserved as fossils; because the particles are tiny, they are called "microfossils". The sporopollenin walls of different groups of plants have different features, such as pores, longitudinal grooves or carved-like patterns, by which the plant species can be identified. Palynologists obtained a drilling sample from a mud core drilled at site 甲 in Taiwan; the sedimentation ages of the mud core at different depths were calculated by carbon-14 isotope dating, and it was found that the mud core has a sedimentary history of about 4000 years.

The palynologists then identified the plant pollen and spore microfossils in the mud core at different depths, and found large amounts of pollen of grasses (Poaceae), mangroves and cattails, among which the cattail is a herbaceous plant that grows in wet, waterlogged marsh environments. The palynologists calculated the percentage of pollen content in each layer of the mud core and obtained the relative pollen abundance diagram in Figure 9, hoping to use these stratified pollen records to reconstruct the process of plant community succession at site 甲. Based on this passage and Figure 9, answer Questions 26–28.

Reading passage 3

The walls of plant spores and pollen (sporopollenin walls) contain a special, highly resistant protein that does not decompose easily. After being dispersed in large quantities, they gradually fall to the ground or sink into the mud at the bottom of water by gravity and are preserved as fossils; because the particles are tiny, they are called "microfossils". The sporopollenin walls of different groups of plants have different features, such as pores, longitudinal grooves or carved-like patterns, by which the plant species can be identified. Palynologists obtained a drilling sample from a mud core drilled at site 甲 in Taiwan; the sedimentation ages of the mud core at different depths were calculated by carbon-14 isotope dating, and it was found that the mud core has a sedimentary history of about 4000 years.

The palynologists then identified the plant pollen and spore microfossils in the mud core at different depths, and found large amounts of pollen of grasses (Poaceae), mangroves and cattails, among which the cattail is a herbaceous plant that grows in wet, waterlogged marsh environments. The palynologists calculated the percentage of pollen content in each layer of the mud core and obtained the relative pollen abundance diagram in Figure 9, hoping to use these stratified pollen records to reconstruct the process of plant community succession at site 甲. Based on this passage and Figure 9, answer Questions 26–28.

Questions 33–34 form a group.

The peppered moth has two body-colour variants, dark and light. Before the Industrial Revolution, the ratio of the black and white forms of peppered moths in Manchester, England, was very unequal, and the melanic form was very rare. Scientists also found that 9 species of birds in the area did significantly prefer to eat the melanic form, leaving the white form. By the end of the 18th century, the numbers of black and white moths were still very unequal, but the ratio had been completely reversed, with black moths making up 98%. Scientists observed that before the Industrial Revolution, tree trunks in England were originally covered with moss and lichens, which gave white moths good camouflage when resting on them, so that birds did not easily find them. After the Industrial Revolution, however, the air was filled with sulphur dioxide and soot that stained the tree trunks, causing the moss and lichens to die and the trunks to turn black, which reduced the chance of black moths being preyed upon so that their numbers gradually became dominant. Scientists believe that during the Industrial Revolution in England, soot darkened the colour of tree trunks and affected the ratio of black to white moths, and therefore put forward the claim that natural selection caused the change in the ratio of black and white moths.

33. Which of the following supports the claim that the Industrial Revolution is related to the ratio of black and white moths?

(A) Birds continued to prey significantly on the melanic peppered moth both before and after the environmental change

(B) Soot changed the environment so that the camouflage effect of peppered moths changed

(C) Sulphur dioxide and soot in the air are more toxic to white moths

(D) After the Industrial Revolution, the white form of peppered moth mutated into the melanic form

(B) 人類造成的環境變化使胡椒蛾快速演化

(C) 胡椒蛾在工業革命前白化型不易突變成黑化型

(D) 黑白胡椒蛾比例的改變主要是天擇的結果

Reading Passage 1

Honeybees are social insects that live in colonies. In a hive there is usually only one queen that can lay eggs to produce offspring; the others are drones and worker bees, the latter being females with incompletely developed ovaries. People are curious about what causes the difference between queens and workers among female bees. Scientists found that when female bees receive different nutritional components, individuals with the same genome can develop differences in morphological and physiological characteristics and thus become either queens or workers.

Nurse bees in the hive produce royal jelly, whose biochemical properties have not yet been elucidated, and feed it to the larvae that will become queens, while food of less complex composition is fed to the other larvae. Scientists proposed the hypothesis that, without any change in the genome sequence, the environmental stimulus caused by these diets affects modifications such as methylation of genomic DNA and acetylation of histones (the proteins around which DNA is wound), and thereby affects the expression of related genes. This hypothesis involves the concept of epigenetics.

To test this hypothesis, scientists used RNA interference technology to affect the total expression level of the mRNA of the DNA methylation enzyme (Dnmt3) in bees. They found that most of the treated bees could not express sufficient Dnmt3, yet their ovaries were able to develop fully. This study clarifies that changes in nutrition or feeding affect epigenetics and thereby change behavioural and physiological characteristics. Based on the text and the related knowledge you have learned, answer Questions 20–22.

20. Regarding this text, which of the following statements are correct?

(A) Epigenetics is unrelated to the cause of social caste differences in honeybees

(B) The gene expression of the queen differs from that of drones and workers

(C) The genomic DNA sequence can change because of different behaviours

(D) This study proves that Dnmt3 is the main component of royal jelly

(E) The ovarian development of queens and workers is different

閱讀一

蜜蜂是行群體生活的社會化昆蟲。在一個蜂巢中，通常僅有一隻可以產卵以繁衍後代的蜂后，其他則為雄蜂及工蜂，後者是卵巢發育不完全的雌蜂。人們好奇什麼因素造成雌蜂有蜂后與工蜂之別？科學家發現：雌蜂獲得不同營養成分，即可造成基因體相同的個體產生形態與生理特徵上的差異，進而成為蜂后或工蜂。

蜂巢中的照護蜜蜂（nurse bees）可產生生物化學特性尚未被解析的蜂王漿，並將此餵給會成為蜂后的幼蟲，成分較不複雜的食物則餵與其他幼蟲。科學家提出假說：在基因體序列沒有改變的情況下，這些飲食所導致的環境刺激，會影響基因體DNA的甲基化及組蛋白（纏繞DNA的蛋白質）的乙醯化等修飾作用，進而影響相關基因表現。此假說所涉即為表觀遺傳學的概念。

為了測試此假說，科學家將蜜蜂體內的DNA甲基化酵素（Dnmt3），以RNA干擾技術影響其mRNA的表現總量。結果發現：大部分處理後的蜜蜂無法表現出足量的Dnmt3，但其卵巢形態卻可發育完全。此研究闡明藉由營養或攝食的改變，影響了表觀遺傳，而改變行為與生理的特性。依本文所述及已習得相關知識，回答20-22題。

(E) 蜂后和工蜂的卵巢發育不一樣

problems.problem:
[Single choice]

Reading Passage 2

Unicellular green algae show behavioural responses to light through the action of light-sensitive ion channels. Under stimulation by light of a specific wavelength, the light-sensitive ion channel protein undergoes a conformational change, which opens the channel and lets cations pass, changing the membrane potential of the algal cell and affecting the behavioural response to light. Scientists exploited the properties of light-sensitive ion channels to develop "optogenetics": specific neurons in the mouse brain are made to carry light-sensitive ion channels, and an optical fibre is then introduced into the brain, so that the activity of these neurons can be controlled by switching light on or off. This revolutionary technological development has allowed neurobiologists to study the workings of the nervous system by methods never available before. The team of Professor Susumu Tonegawa used optogenetics to study the mechanisms of memory formation.

It was known from earlier studies that after a specific group of neurons in the hippocampus is removed, mice lose the ability to form memories and so cannot undergo conditioned learning. To further demonstrate the relationship between this group of cells and the formation of memory, Professor Tonegawa’s team made this group of neurons carry light-sensitive ion channels, then gave the mice conditioned-learning training while also stimulating this group of neurons with light. After a period of rest, without any external stimulus, simply shining light on the brain of the mouse could elicit the specific conditioned behavioural response. If this group of neurons was not stimulated with light at the same time during conditioned learning, the conditioned behavioural response could not be induced by light stimulation alone.

From these results the researchers inferred that this group of neurons is related to the memory needed to generate the conditioned behaviour. Based on the text and the related knowledge you have learned, answer Questions 23–25.

23. Based on the text above, on which structure of the green algal cell should the light-sensitive ion channel protein be located?

(A) Nucleus

(B) Chloroplast

(C) Cell membrane

(D) Mitochondrion

[單選題]

閱讀二

單細胞綠藻透過光敏感離子通道的作用，產生對光的行為反應。在特定波長光線刺激下，光敏感離子通道蛋白產生構形變化，使通道開啟，讓陽離子通過，使藻類細胞的膜電位產生變化，影響對光的行為反應。科學家利用光敏感離子通道的特性，發展出「光遺傳技術」，使小鼠腦部特定的神經細胞具有光敏感離子通道，再將光纖管引入腦中，即可以用光的開或關來控制這些神經細胞的活性。這個革命性的技術發展，使神經生物學家能以前所未有的方法，來研究神經系統的運作。利根川進教授團隊即是以光遺傳技術來研究記憶形成的機制。

由先前研究中得知，剔除海馬迴內一群特定神經細胞後，小鼠會失去記憶能力，以致無法進行制約學習。為進一步證明這群細胞與記憶能力形成的關係，利根川進教授團隊使這群神經細胞具有光敏感離子通道，再給予小鼠制約學習訓練，同時也以光刺激這群神經細胞。經過一段時間的休息之後，無須給予外在刺激，只要對小鼠腦部施以光照就能引起專一的制約行為反應。若在進行制約學習時，沒有同步以光刺激這群神經細胞，則無法單以光刺激誘發此制約行為反應。

藉由這些結果，研究者推斷這群神經細胞與生成制約行為所需的記憶有關。依本文所述及已習得相關知識，回答23-25題。

(B) 葉綠體

(C) 細胞膜

(D) 粒線體

Reading Passage 2

Unicellular green algae show behavioural responses to light through the action of light-sensitive ion channels. Under stimulation by light of a specific wavelength, the light-sensitive ion channel protein undergoes a conformational change, which opens the channel and lets cations pass, changing the membrane potential of the algal cell and affecting the behavioural response to light. Scientists exploited the properties of light-sensitive ion channels to develop "optogenetics": specific neurons in the mouse brain are made to carry light-sensitive ion channels, and an optical fibre is then introduced into the brain, so that the activity of these neurons can be controlled by switching light on or off. This revolutionary technological development has allowed neurobiologists to study the workings of the nervous system by methods never available before. The team of Professor Susumu Tonegawa used optogenetics to study the mechanisms of memory formation.

It was known from earlier studies that after a specific group of neurons in the hippocampus is removed, mice lose the ability to form memories and so cannot undergo conditioned learning. To further demonstrate the relationship between this group of cells and the formation of memory, Professor Tonegawa’s team made this group of neurons carry light-sensitive ion channels, then gave the mice conditioned-learning training while also stimulating this group of neurons with light. After a period of rest, without any external stimulus, simply shining light on the brain of the mouse could elicit the specific conditioned behavioural response. If this group of neurons was not stimulated with light at the same time during conditioned learning, the conditioned behavioural response could not be induced by light stimulation alone.

From these results the researchers inferred that this group of neurons is related to the memory needed to generate the conditioned behaviour. Based on the text and the related knowledge you have learned, answer Questions 23–25.

(C) Potassium ion

(D) Calcium ion

閱讀二

單細胞綠藻透過光敏感離子通道的作用，產生對光的行為反應。在特定波長光線刺激下，光敏感離子通道蛋白產生構形變化，使通道開啟，讓陽離子通過，使藻類細胞的膜電位產生變化，影響對光的行為反應。科學家利用光敏感離子通道的特性，發展出「光遺傳技術」，使小鼠腦部特定的神經細胞具有光敏感離子通道，再將光纖管引入腦中，即可以用光的開或關來控制這些神經細胞的活性。這個革命性的技術發展，使神經生物學家能以前所未有的方法，來研究神經系統的運作。利根川進教授團隊即是以光遺傳技術來研究記憶形成的機制。

由先前研究中得知，剔除海馬迴內一群特定神經細胞後，小鼠會失去記憶能力，以致無法進行制約學習。為進一步證明這群細胞與記憶能力形成的關係，利根川進教授團隊使這群神經細胞具有光敏感離子通道，再給予小鼠制約學習訓練，同時也以光刺激這群神經細胞。經過一段時間的休息之後，無須給予外在刺激，只要對小鼠腦部施以光照就能引起專一的制約行為反應。若在進行制約學習時，沒有同步以光刺激這群神經細胞，則無法單以光刺激誘發此制約行為反應。

藉由這些結果，研究者推斷這群神經細胞與生成制約行為所需的記憶有關。依本文所述及已習得相關知識，回答23-25題。

尼倫伯格因為破解密碼子對應的胺基酸，而與另外兩位科學家共同獲得1968年諾貝爾生醫獎。

在1961年，他先將大腸桿菌碎裂，然後得到無細胞萃取物，並在其中加入人工合成的多聚尿嘧啶核苷酸鏈（poly-U），接著進行不同組合的測試（加入19種未標記的胺基酸及1種以放射性碳-14標記的胺基酸等成分），最終他們發現苯丙胺酸（Phenylalanine; Phe），可在此系統中形成苯丙胺酸多聚肽，由此破解了第一個密碼子所代表的胺基酸。

1964年，尼倫伯格使用表3甲至戊的研究材料，繼續進行深入研究，逐一解出所有密碼子對應的胺基酸。依本文所述及已習得相關知識，回答26-28題。

表3

$$\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|}\hline \text{甲} & \text{乙} & \text{丙} & \text{丁} & \text{戊} \\ \hline \text{含三個核苷酸的迷你mRNA} & \text{核糖體} & \text{19種附著於tRNA上的未標記胺基酸} & \text{1種附著於tRNA上並以放射性碳-14標記的胺基酸} & \text{一種核糖體無法通過的濾膜} \\ \hline \end{array}$$

(B) 若將細胞萃取物進行$95^\circ\mathrm{C}$加熱，可以讓實驗產出的放射線訊號加強

(D) 若加入核糖核酸分解酶（RNase），本實驗仍可以順利進行

Marchantia (liverwort) is a bryophyte; besides sexual reproduction it also has the ability to reproduce asexually. The thallus of Marchantia bears gemma cups, within which many gemmae are produced. After each gemma detaches from the original thallus, it can develop independently into a complete Marchantia plant.

Research found a Marchantia mutant in which the function of the gene (log) encoding the synthase of a certain plant hormone is lost, resulting in changes in morphology (Figure 10 甲). In addition, scientists added different concentrations of cytokinin (abbreviated BA) to wild-type and log mutant Marchantia and observed changes in the number of gemma cups and in thallus morphology; the results are shown in Figure 10 乙 and 丙.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/biology-olympiads-bank/main/images/twbio-2025-1-fig10.png

Figure labels (Chinese → English): 野生型 → wild type; log 突變株 → log mutant; 珠芽杯 → gemma cup; 葉狀體 → thallus; 假根 → rhizoid; 俯視 → top view; 側面 → side view; 珠芽杯形成比率 → gemma cup formation rate

(D) Experiments proved that BA is the protein expressed by the log gene

研究發現有一地錢突變株，其某種植物激素的合成酶基因（log）功能發生缺失，結果導致形態上發生改變（圖10甲）。此外，科學家利用不同濃度的細胞分裂素（簡稱BA）添加在野生型及log突變株地錢中，並觀察其珠芽杯數量及葉狀體形態的變化，結果如圖10乙、丙所示。

Reading 1

The fluid mosaic model of the cell membrane, proposed by Singer and Nicolson in 1972, states that the phospholipids and proteins that make up the cell membrane can move laterally and drift freely in the plane of the membrane, but that, without the help of specific transport proteins, molecules are rarely exchanged between the two layers of the phospholipid bilayer. The results of many later experiments broadly support the fluid character of this model, but they also show that the cell membrane is not a homogeneous structure, and the movement of phospholipids and membrane proteins in the membrane is restricted. There are many factors that affect the flow of molecules in the cell membrane, two of which are related to the structure of the cell membrane.

The cell membrane of animal cells contains a lot of cholesterol. Compared with ordinary phospholipids, the molecular structure of cholesterol contains four carbon rings and is bulky and lacking in plasticity. When packed in the lipid bilayer, cholesterol has a higher affinity for phospholipids containing saturated fatty acids. Cholesterol is unevenly distributed in the cell membrane and its content is particularly high in membrane regions called "lipid rafts". Lipid rafts are also regions where many receptor proteins are concentrated and are a key structure for the signal-transmission function of the cell membrane.

The membrane skeleton is another structure that affects the flow of molecules in the cell membrane. It is composed of microfilaments closely attached to the inner side of the cell membrane and many membrane proteins of the cell membrane that can bind to the microfilaments. The membrane skeleton has the function of maintaining the specific shape of the cell, but so that processes including cell movement can proceed smoothly, the binding between the microfilaments of the membrane skeleton and the membrane proteins is dynamically adjusted at all times.

閱讀一

辛格與尼克森在西元1972 年提出的細胞膜流體鑲嵌模型指出，組成細胞膜的磷脂質與蛋白質可以在膜的平面上自由橫向移動與漂移，但在缺乏特定傳遞蛋白協助下，雙層磷脂質間的分子極少發生互換。後續許多實驗結果大致支持此模型的流體特性，但也顯示細胞膜並非是均質的構造，磷脂質與膜蛋白在膜上的移動會受到局限。影響細胞膜分子流動的原因很多，其中有兩個與細胞膜的構造相關。

動物細胞的細胞膜含有許多膽固醇，相對於一般磷脂質，膽固醇的分子結構中含有四個碳環，體積龐大又缺乏可塑性。堆疊在脂雙層構造中時，膽固醇與含有飽和脂肪酸的磷脂質間具有較高的親和性。膽固醇在細胞膜中的分布不均勻，在稱為「脂筏」的細胞膜區塊中含量特別高。脂筏也是許多受體蛋白質集中分布的區域，是細胞膜訊息傳遞功能的關鍵構造。

細胞膜骨架是另一個影響細胞膜分子流動的構造，它是由緊貼在細胞膜內側的微絲，以及細胞膜上許多能與微絲接合的膜蛋白所組成。細胞膜骨架具有維持細胞特定形狀的功能，但為了讓包括細胞移動等作用順利進行，細胞膜骨架微絲與膜蛋白的結合會隨時進行動態調整。

It is composed of microfilaments closely attached to the inner side of the cell membrane and many membrane proteins of the cell membrane that can bind to the microfilaments. The membrane skeleton has the function of maintaining the specific shape of the cell, but so that processes including cell movement can proceed smoothly, the binding between the microfilaments of the membrane skeleton and the membrane proteins is dynamically adjusted at all times.

辛格與尼克森在西元1972 年提出的細胞膜流體鑲嵌模型指出，組成細胞膜的磷脂質與蛋白質可以在膜的平面上自由橫向移動與漂移，但在缺乏特定傳遞蛋白協助下，雙層磷脂質間的分子極少發生互換。後續許多實驗結果大致支持此模型的流體特性，但也顯示細胞膜並非是均質的構造，磷脂質與膜蛋白在膜上的移動會受到局限。影響細胞膜分子流動的原因很多，其中有兩個與細胞膜的構造相關。

動物細胞的細胞膜含有許多膽固醇，相對於一般磷脂質，膽固醇的分子結構中含有四個碳環，體積龐大又缺乏可塑性。堆疊在脂雙層構造中時，膽固醇與含有飽和脂肪酸的磷脂質間具有較高的親和性。膽固醇在細胞膜中的分布不均勻，在稱為「脂筏」的細胞膜區塊中含量特別高。脂筏也是許多受體蛋白質集中分布的區域，是細胞膜訊息傳遞功能的關鍵構造。

細胞膜骨架是另一個影響細胞膜分子流動的構造，它是由緊貼在細胞膜內側的微絲，以及細胞膜上許多能與微絲接合的膜蛋白所組成。細胞膜骨架具有維持細胞特定形狀的功能，但為了讓包括細胞移動等作用順利進行，細胞膜骨架微絲與膜蛋白的結合會隨時進行動態調整。

Reading 2

Populations of the Mexican tetra (Astyanax mexicanus) living in different environments show a high degree of morphological difference, for example the eyed populations living in surface rivers and the eyeless populations living in underground limestone caves. Although their external appearance and physiological characteristics differ considerably, the two still belong to the same species. The phylogenetic tree (Figure 3) constructed from molecular sequences shows that the different cave populations should have formed independently after surface populations entered caves separately at different times and places. These cave populations are isolated from one another, yet they have all, coincidentally, undergone trait changes such as the loss of the eyes. This phenomenon of independently evolving the same phenotype is called "parallel evolution".

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/biology-olympiads-bank/main/images/twbio-2026-1-fig3.png

Figure labels (Chinese → English): 地表河流 → surface river; 洞穴 → cave; 族群 → population (e.g. 洞穴甲族群 → cave 甲 population; 地表河流 1 族群 → surface river 1 population)

Scientists found that the expression level of the gene for a signalling molecule called Shh is significantly higher in the embryos of the eyeless cave populations than in those of the eyed surface populations, whereas the expression level of the Pax6 gene, which directs eye development, is relatively lower. If the Shh gene is overexpressed in the embryos of the eyed surface populations, the expression level of the Pax6 gene is reduced because it is inhibited by the Shh signalling molecule. The Pax6 protein can promote the proliferation of eye cells, so a reduced expression level of the Pax6 gene further leads to abnormal shrinking of the eyes.

In addition, raising the expression level of the Shh gene also greatly increases the number of taste buds at the same time and enlarges the region of the brain in charge of the sense of smell. Scientists further compared cave populations at different geographic locations and found that all of these independently evolved populations show increased expression of the Shh gene and decreased expression of the Pax6 gene, which shows that underground cave populations can repeatedly use the same changes in gene regulation to produce parallel evolution of multiple traits.

閱讀二

墨西哥麗脂鯉（Astyanax mexicanus）生活在不同環境的族群具有高度的形態差異，例如棲息於地表河流的有眼族群，以及生活於地底石灰岩洞穴中的無眼族群。儘管外觀與生理特徵差異相當大，兩者仍屬於同一物種。根據分子序列所建構的親緣關係圖（圖3）顯示，不同的洞穴族群應該是由地表族群在不同時間、地點分別進入洞穴後獨立形成。這些洞穴族群彼此隔離，卻不約而同發生如失去眼睛之類的性狀改變。此種獨立演化出相同表徵的現象即稱為「平行演化」。

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/biology-olympiads-bank/main/images/twbio-2026-1-fig3.png

科學家發現，名為Shh 的訊息分子基因表現量在洞穴無眼族群的胚胎中，顯著高於地表有眼族群，而主導眼部發育的Pax6 基因表現量則相對較低。若使地表有眼族群的胚胎過度表現Shh 基因，Pax6 基因的表現量便會受到Shh 訊息分子抑制而降低。Pax6蛋白可促進眼部細胞增生，故Pax6 基因表現量降低會進一步導致其眼睛異常縮小。

此外，提高Shh 基因表現量也會同時大幅增加味蕾數量，並使大腦掌管嗅覺的區域變大。科學家進一步比較不同地理位置的洞穴族群，發現這些獨立演化的族群都有Shh 基因表現量提升與Pax6 基因表現量下降的現象，顯示地底洞穴族群可反覆以同樣的基因調控變化來產生多種性狀的平行演化。

Reading 3

Carotenoids are a group of fat-soluble organic pigments found in plants and in photosynthetic algae. The earlier development of "golden rice" also aimed at increasing the synthesis of carotenoids in rice grains. Because β-carotene can be converted into vitamin A in the human body, it was used to improve the problem of deficiency. Recently it has been found that carotenoid metabolites play an important role in prolonging seed longevity.

Phytoene synthase (PSY) is an important key enzyme in the process of carotenoid biosynthesis. Strains in which the PSY gene is overexpressed have significantly prolonged seed longevity, and the content of reactive oxygen species (ROS, oxygen-containing reactive molecules produced by the metabolism of organisms) in the plant body is lower. By comparison, the survival rate of seeds from psy mutants is reduced at high ROS levels. Lutein and β-carotene can generally be detected in seeds at the same time.

However, among the many carotenoids, only β-carotene and its derived metabolites (β-cyclic compounds and β-ionone) can prolong seed longevity. The enzymes CCD1 and CCD4 can specifically cleave carotenoids, breaking them down into other, smaller molecular products. In ccd1/4 double-mutant plants, seed longevity is found to be significantly reduced, and even overexpressing the PSY gene in the ccd1/4 double mutant reduces seed longevity. These results support the necessity of the cleavage of β-carotene for preserving seed longevity and emphasise the importance of seed carotenoids in agriculture.

類胡蘿蔔素是一群脂溶性有機色素，存在於植物及行光合作用的藻類中。先前「黃金米」的開發，也是以增加稻米中類胡蘿蔔素的合成為目標。利用β-胡蘿蔔素在人體能轉變成維生素A，以改善缺乏的問題。近來發現類胡蘿蔔素代謝物，在延長種子壽命中扮演重要角色。

植物烯合酶（PSY）為類胡蘿蔔素生物合成過程中重要的關鍵酵素，PSY 基因過量表現品系的種子壽命顯著延長，且植物體內的活性氧（ROS，生物體代謝產生的含氧活性分子）含量較低。相較之下，來自psy 突變體的種子在高ROS 水平下存活率降低。一般種子中能同時檢測到葉黃素和β-胡蘿蔔素。

然而眾多類胡蘿蔔素中，只有β-胡蘿蔔素及其衍生代謝物（β-環狀物和β-離子酮）能延長種子壽命。CCD1 和CCD4 酵素能專一性切割類胡蘿蔔素，使其裂解成其他較小的分子產物。在ccd1/4 雙突變體植物中，可發現種子壽命顯著降低，即使在ccd1/4 雙突變體中過量表現PSY 基因，也會降低種子壽命。這些結果支持β-胡蘿蔔素的裂解對保存種子壽命的必要性，並強調種子類胡蘿蔔素在農業中的重要性。

閱讀三

類胡蘿蔔素是一群脂溶性有機色素，存在於植物及行光合作用的藻類中。先前「黃金米」的開發，也是以增加稻米中類胡蘿蔔素的合成為目標。利用β-胡蘿蔔素在人體能轉變成維生素A，以改善缺乏的問題。近來發現類胡蘿蔔素代謝物，在延長種子壽命中扮演重要角色。

植物烯合酶（PSY）為類胡蘿蔔素生物合成過程中重要的關鍵酵素，PSY 基因過量表現品系的種子壽命顯著延長，且植物體內的活性氧（ROS，生物體代謝產生的含氧活性分子）含量較低。相較之下，來自psy 突變體的種子在高ROS 水平下存活率降低。一般種子中能同時檢測到葉黃素和β-胡蘿蔔素。

然而眾多類胡蘿蔔素中，只有β-胡蘿蔔素及其衍生代謝物（β-環狀物和β-離子酮）能延長種子壽命。CCD1 和CCD4 酵素能專一性切割類胡蘿蔔素，使其裂解成其他較小的分子產物。在ccd1/4 雙突變體植物中，可發現種子壽命顯著降低，即使在ccd1/4 雙突變體中過量表現PSY 基因，也會降低種子壽命。這些結果支持β-胡蘿蔔素的裂解對保存種子壽命的必要性，並強調種子類胡蘿蔔素在農業中的重要性。

Reading 3

Carotenoids are a group of fat-soluble organic pigments found in plants and in photosynthetic algae. The earlier development of "golden rice" also aimed at increasing the synthesis of carotenoids in rice grains. Because β-carotene can be converted into vitamin A in the human body, it was used to improve the problem of deficiency. Recently it has been found that carotenoid metabolites play an important role in prolonging seed longevity.

Phytoene synthase (PSY) is an important key enzyme in the process of carotenoid biosynthesis. Strains in which the PSY gene is overexpressed have significantly prolonged seed longevity, and the content of reactive oxygen species (ROS, oxygen-containing reactive molecules produced by the metabolism of organisms) in the plant body is lower. By comparison, the survival rate of seeds from psy mutants is reduced at high ROS levels. Lutein and β-carotene can generally be detected in seeds at the same time.

However, among the many carotenoids, only β-carotene and its derived metabolites (β-cyclic compounds and β-ionone) can prolong seed longevity. The enzymes CCD1 and CCD4 can specifically cleave carotenoids, breaking them down into other, smaller molecular products. In ccd1/4 double-mutant plants, seed longevity is found to be significantly reduced, and even overexpressing the PSY gene in the ccd1/4 double mutant reduces seed longevity. These results support the necessity of the cleavage of β-carotene for preserving seed longevity and emphasise the importance of seed carotenoids in agriculture.

problems.problem:
[Multiple choice — one or more correct options]

Questions 36–37 form a group.

The hypothalamus secretes thyrotropin-releasing hormone (TRH), which stimulates the anterior pituitary to secrete thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH); TSH stimulates the thyroid gland through the bloodstream to secrete thyroxine, and excess thyroxine exerts feedback regulation on the release of TRH and TSH. Iodine is an important element for making thyroxine. If the human body lacks iodine because of iodine-deficient food, the production of thyroxine falls, and this on the contrary causes the thyroid gland to enlarge, which is called iodine-deficiency goitre.

Graves’ disease is an autoimmune disease in which the patient's body produces antibodies that over-stimulate the TSH receptors on thyroid cells, causing the thyroid gland to proliferate and enlarge and to secrete too much thyroxine. Answer Questions 36–37 based on this passage and what you have learned.

36. Which of the following statements about thyroxine or its regulation are correct?

(A) Over-stimulation of the TSH receptors of thyroid cells causes the autoimmune Graves’ disease

(B) Thyroxine inhibits the secretion of TRH and TSH, which is a negative feedback mechanism

(C) An excessive amount of thyroxine can be detected in the blood of all patients with an enlarged thyroid

(D) An excessive amount of TRH can be detected in the blood of all patients with an enlarged thyroid

(E) The blood of patients with iodine-deficiency goitre contains excessive amounts of TRH and TSH

Questions 38–39 form a group.

A student went to see a doctor because of a bacterial infection. The doctor prescribed a 7-day course of antibiotics and especially instructed: "Even if you feel well after taking the medicine for 3 days, you must never stop taking it on your own; you must finish all 7 days of medicine, so as to avoid producing drug-resistant superbugs in the future."

38. Regarding the biological principle behind the doctor's instruction, which of the following explanations is the most correct?

(A) When the concentration of the antibiotic suddenly falls, bacteria can change their metabolic pathways to adapt to and resist the drug

(B) Stopping the medicine early induces mutations in the surviving bacteria that produce genes able to resist the action of the antibiotic

(C) A complete course gives the immune system enough time to remember and itself synthesise the same antibiotic

(D) Stopping the medicine early gives bacteria with higher tolerance to the drug a chance to survive, and superbugs then appear
